releases.title: Wondershare Filmora 16 Launches to Make Professional Video Creation More Accessible with AI
releases.body:
VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wondershare Filmora, a flagship video creativity software developed by Wondershare, has officially launched its new version, Filmora 16. Built around the new "Edit as an Expert with Filmora & AI" positioning, Filmora 16 brings a broad range of AI-powered and professional capabilities designed to reduce tedious editing work, give creators greater control, and make professional creativity more accessible.

With this major version, Wondershare Filmora extends its capabilities across the entire video creation workflow, from understanding source material and taking control of the edit to shaping creative expression and delivering finished content. Highlights include AI Media Analysis for smarter footage understanding, Camera Tracking and Color Mask for more precise editing, and 360° Video Reframing for greater creative flexibility. Alongside a wider range of new and upgraded capabilities, Filmora V16 is designed for aspiring and emerging video creators, including YouTube creators and small marketing teams, helping them create more ambitious content with less complexity.

Understand Every Source

Video creation starts with understanding what you have to work with. Footage can come from different devices and formats, and creators need to quickly identify what each asset contains before deciding what belongs in the final edit. Filmora 16 makes this first stage easier by bringing source material into one editing workflow while helping creators analyze, organize, and find the content they need.

Key capabilities:

  • AI Media Analysis & Smart Media Bin — AI Media Analysis helps creators understand video and image assets by identifying key visual content and generating searchable tags, descriptions, and editing suggestions. The analyzed assets can then be organized in Smart Media Bin, making it easier to browse, filter, and locate useful footage across larger media libraries.
  • Multi-source Recording — Records screen, camera, microphone, and system audio as separate sources that can move directly into the editing timeline.
  • Game Recording — Provides a dedicated recording mode for supported game windows, with the captured footage ready for editing in Filmora.

Take Professional Control

Once the source material is understood, creators need precise control over how it appears and behaves in the frame. Professional editing often involves following moving subjects, isolating specific areas, managing layers, or adjusting color. Filmora 16 brings these controls into a more accessible editing workflow, making complex visual adjustments easier to manage without adding unnecessary complexity.

Key capabilities:

  • Camera Tracking — Tracks a head, body, or custom area and enables camera-following effects without relying on complex manual keyframing.
  • Color Mask — Applies color adjustments to selected areas of a frame, giving creators more precise control over local color treatment.
  • Track Matte — Uses one layer to control the visible area of another, enabling more flexible compositing effects.
  • Auto Color — Automatically improves common color and exposure issues.

Shape Your Creative Vision

With the footage organized and the edit under control, creators can shape how their content looks, moves, and communicates. Filmora 16 expands the creative possibilities across visual movement, text, captions, and immersive footage, giving creators more ways to develop a distinct visual style and bring their ideas to the screen.

Key capabilities:

  • Video Animation — Provides In, Out, and Combo animations with more control over movement within a clip, supporting more flexible visual rhythm and transitions.
  • 360° Video Reframing — Lets creators reframe 360° footage, adjust viewing angles, and use keyframes and camera-movement presets to create dynamic shots.
  • Automatic Correction — Identifies common transcription errors and provides correction suggestions, while allowing repeated errors to be corrected together and terms to be added to a personal dictionary.
  • Subtitle Track — Separates subtitle content into dedicated tracks for more structured editing, styling, export, and multilingual management.
  • Dynamic Caption — Applies visual caption styles and templates to help spoken content become part of the video's visual rhythm.
  • Keyframe Motion Blur — Helps animated elements move more naturally by adding blur to keyframed motion.

Deliver With Less Friction

The final stage of video creation often involves more than exporting a single finished file. Projects may need to move between editing tools, versions may need to be prepared for different uses, and content may need to move across devices. Filmora 16 streamlines these final steps, making it easier to export, transfer, and continue working wherever the content needs to go.

Key capabilities:

  • XML Import/Export — Brings compatible timeline structures into Filmora and exports projects for basic cross-software editing workflows.
  • Batch Export — Processes multiple export tasks together, reducing repetitive manual work when several versions are needed.

For teams working on more structured commercial and branded video projects, Wondershare also offers Filmora.TV, a browser-based AI creative studio that brings visual planning, AI content generation, editing, and team collaboration together in one workspace. The platform is designed for agencies, brand teams, and commercial creators who need a connected workflow from initial concept to production-ready video. More information is available at Filmora.TV.

"AI is changing what is possible in video creation," said Christy Wu, Vice President at Wondershare. "Filmora 16 reflects our continued investment in making professional creative capabilities more intuitive and accessible, giving creators more room to focus on their ideas and their craft. We believe technology should expand the possibilities of creativity, and we are committed to building products that help more people create, communicate, and bring their ideas into the world."

Wondershare Filmora 16 is now available for creators looking to bring more professional control and creative flexibility into their video workflows. To learn more and experience the latest version, visit Wondershare Filmora.

About Filmora

Launched in 2015, Wondershare Filmora is designed with its user in mind, featuring smoother performance and an intuitive user interface, and has attracted a cumulative global user base of nearly 400 million across 150+ countries and regions. With advanced features boosting content generation and editing, over 2.9+ million creative assets, commercially available music, dynamic captions, video animations, and pre-set templates, Filmora stands out as a leader in video editing software. Consistently introducing innovative tools, it enhances video creation and makes the process more efficient and accessible for all skill levels.

About Wondershare:

Wondershare is a globally recognized software company founded in 2003, known for its innovative solutions in creativity and productivity. Driven by the mission "Creativity Simplified", Wondershare offers a range of tools, including Filmora, Virbo and SelfyzAI for video editing; PDFelement for document management; and EdrawMax, EdrawMind for diagramming. With over 2 billion cumulative active users across all products and a presence in over 200 countries and regions, Wondershare empowers the next generation of creators with intuitive software and trendy creative resources, continually expanding the possibilities of creativity worldwide.

releases.title: Guideline Ends the Media Plan Re-Entry Bottleneck with Launch of New AI Ingestion Agent
releases.body:
The new agent reads media plan spreadsheets in any format and turns them into clean, governed data in seconds.

NEW YORK, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Guideline, a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management solutions, today launched the AI Ingestion Agent in its Media Plan Management platform. The agent takes the spreadsheet media plans agencies and brands already use and turns them into structured, governed data in seconds.

Most media plans still start in a spreadsheet, and every agency, team, market and client lays them out differently. Getting a plan into a system of record has meant re-entering it by hand, which takes time, introduces errors, and delays the moment when finance, leadership and operations teams can see and act on the plan. The AI Ingestion Agent removes that manual step without requiring teams to change how they build plans.

With the AI Ingestion Agent, planning teams can:

  • Start from their existing file. Upload an Excel or CSV file to create a new plan.
  • Automate field mapping. The agent reads each column and suggests how it maps to the customer's plan templates and fields.
  • Review before anything is saved. Fields the agent is less certain about are flagged, and nothing is committed until the planner confirms it.
  • Use the plan right away. Once confirmed, the plan is structured data that can be used for reporting, budget tracking and actuals reconciliation.

Uploaded files are validated so that only supported plan formats are processed, and customer plan data is not used to train AI models. Each upload is saved as a new plan version rather than overwriting earlier work, so every change can be traced. This new product capability ships with enterprise controls. It is opt-in and enabled per customer. This first release creates new plans from spreadsheets; updating existing plans and bulk-importing historical ones will follow.

"Every customer's spreadsheet looks different, and for years that has been the hardest part of getting plans into a system of record," said Vincent Mifsud, Chief Executive Officer at Guideline. "The sooner a plan becomes governed data, the sooner it can be measured, reconciled and improved. That is central to making Media Plan Management the trusted source of truth for the more than $300 billion in media budgets our customers manage with us."

"Planners shouldn't have to retype a plan to get it into a governed platform," said Steve Silvers, Chief Product Officer at Guideline. "The agent works with the files teams already use and handles the mapping for them. We built it to save planners time without taking decisions out of their hands."

Availability: The AI Ingestion Agent is available now for enterprise customers. To learn more or schedule a demo, contact sales@guideline.ai or visit www.guideline.ai.

About Guideline

Guideline is a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management technology for the world's leading brands, agencies, media owners and investors. Its solutions help enterprises understand advertising markets, manage media plans and make more informed decisions across the buying and selling ecosystem. Guideline's media plan management solutions support more than $300 billion in managed media budgets across more than 60,000 active media plans and 10,000+ monthly users. Its proprietary spend and pricing data represents approximately $200 billion in annual media investment across 65 countries worldwide.

For more information, visit www.guideline.ai.

releases.title: Parents Anonymous® Launches Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa Podcast on Parent and Youth Mental Health on World Mental Health Day
releases.body:
First episode premieres Saturday, October 10, 2026, on World Mental Health Day

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Parents Anonymous, Inc. today announced the launch of Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa, a new podcast featuring honest conversations about the strengths and challenges parents and young people face every day. Hosted by Parents Anonymous President and CEO Dr. Lisa Pion-Berlin, the podcast is founded on one core belief: Asking for Help is a Sign of Strength®.

Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa premieres Saturday, Oct. 10, on World Mental Health Day. Each episode will feature parents, young people and advocates sharing firsthand experiences with mental health, family pressures and the decision to reach out for support.

"Too many parents, children and youth feel like they have to hide what they are going through or wait until things get worse before reaching out," Dr. Lisa Pion-Berlin said. "This podcast is about making those conversations more honest, more visible and more human. If even one person hears these stories and realizes they are not alone, that matters."

The first episode, "When Your Child Is Struggling: Finding Strength in Asking for Help," features Aurora, a Latina mother of two sharing her family's experience navigating her daughter's anxiety and panic attacks.

Upcoming episodes will explore parenting a child with special needs while navigating family loss; bullying, social media and youth mental health; the pressures of caring for aging parents and an adult child at the same time; substance use and recovery; and the power of parent leadership.

While many parenting and mental health podcasts focus primarily on expert interviews, commentary or advice, Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa takes a story-led approach. Parents, young people and advocates speak directly about what they experienced, how those challenges affected their daily lives, why asking for help felt difficult and what changed when someone listened without judgment. The series spans a range of family experiences, giving parents, children and youth more opportunities to hear stories that reflect their own lives. The conversations also reinforce that needing support does not make someone weak and that reaching out is a courageous first step.

Following the Oct. 10 premiere, additional episodes will be released monthly. Listeners can follow Breaking the Stigma with Dr. Lisa on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify and other major podcast platforms.

Parents, children and youth seeking emotional support can call or text the National Parent & Youth Helpline™ at 855-427-2736 or start a live chat at NationalParentYouthHelpline.org. Support is available at no cost, 24 hours a day, seven days a week with no blame and shame.

About Parents Anonymous, Inc.

Parents Anonymous® is a leader in evidence-based programs dedicated to building on the strengths of parents, children and youth to foster family and community well-being. Parents Anonymous Weekly Adult and Children & Youth Groups is recognized by The Federal Title IV-E Prevention Clearinghouse as proven to Effectively Improve Parenting, Enhance Mental Health and Reduce Substance Abuse while Ensuring Child Safety for parents, children and youth of all ages. The organization also operates the National Parent & Youth Helpline™ and California Parent & Youth Helpline®, the only positive research-backed, no-cost helpline nationwide. Emotional support is provided by trained counselors, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by calling/texting 1-855-427-2736 or through live chat at nationalparentyouthhelpline.org and caparentyouthhelpline.org.

releases.title: Tractor Named to the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production™ List
releases.body:
Farmer-founded, employee-owned beverage company ranks No. 34 among small and medium workplaces

DENVER, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tractor Beverage Company has been named to the 2026 Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production™ list, ranking No. 34 in the small and medium company category. Produced by Great Place To Work®, the list recognizes companies based on employees' feedback about their workplace experience.

For Tractor, the recognition celebrates the people who bring its "soil and soul" ethos to life and carry forward its Founder's Intent: to make organic beverages more accessible and to help build a better food system rooted in healthier soil. It reflects the care, creativity, and commitment employees bring to their work and to one another.

That spirit is at the heart of Tractor's "business as unusual" ethos: building a company where care for people, commitment to organic agriculture and healthier soil are part of the same purpose. Fully remote since day one, Tractor gives employees flexibility in where they work while creating shared experiences that connect them to the land and to one another.

Each team member receives financial support for a community-supported agriculture (CSA) membership, bringing the company's commitment to farmers into everyday life. Through Farm Camp, employees spend time on the farm, deepening their understanding of the soil, the people who tend it and the work behind the ingredients in Tractor's beverages.

"The people at Tractor are the heart of this company," said Kevin Sherman, CEO of Tractor Beverage Company. "They bring curiosity, conviction and care to the work every day. This recognition belongs to them, and it reminds us of our responsibility to keep building a company where people feel valued and proud of what we're growing together."

The ranking follows Tractor's July 2025 employee survey through Great Place To Work. The assessment gave employees an opportunity to share their experiences and helped inform the company's recognition on the 2026 list.

"Culture grows through the everyday ways we show up for one another," said John Martin, Chief People and Culture Officer at Tractor Beverage Company. "It's listening, making room for different perspectives, and recognizing that people bring their whole lives to work. Hearing directly from our team makes this honor especially meaningful and gives us a foundation to keep learning and growing together."

Great Place To Work evaluates confidential employee feedback on trust, respect, fairness and other aspects of workplace culture. The small and medium category includes eligible companies with 10 to 999 employees in the United States.

The Fortune recognition adds to a growing record of honors for Tractor's culture, innovation and growth. Tractor was named to Fast Company's 2025 Flexible Workplaces for Innovation list, part of its annual Best Workplaces for Innovators program, recognizing the company's remote culture and Farm Camp immersion. Tractor also earned a place on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies for a fifth consecutive year in 2026. Its broader innovation honors include Fast Company's World Changing Ideas recognition for the Organic Impact Tracker in 2024 and Tractor Beam in 2026, alongside NEXTY and FABI awards for Haymaker, its organic sparkling apple cider vinegar tonic.

To view the full list, visit Great Place To Work.

About Tractor Beverage Company

Farmer-founded and employee-owned, Tractor is built on the belief that a better food system starts with the land—and the people who care for it. Every beverage is crafted with certified organic ingredients and a commitment to supporting soil health. We're here to make drinks that taste great, deliver real impact, and help raise awareness for regenerative practices that nourish both the earth and the communities it sustains. Through the Farmhand Foundation, we support growers in their transition to organic farming and work to expand the domestic supply chain, ensuring farmers prosper, ecosystems thrive, and the regenerative organic market continues to grow. And with our Organic Impact Tracker, we provide unprecedented transparency into the environmental benefits of organic sourcing, helping partners see the measurable difference every sip makes.

For more information, visit drinktractor.com or follow @drinktractor on Instagram.

releases.title: CORUS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETES RECAPITALIZATION TRANSACTION; ANNOUNCES NEW BOARD APPOINTMENTS
releases.body:
TORONTO, Oct. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- Corus Entertainment Inc. ("CEI") (TSX: CJR.B) announced today that it has successfully completed its previously announced recapitalization transaction (the "Recapitalization Transaction"), pursuant to a plan of arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act (the "Plan"). As a result, CEI has become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Corus Entertainment Holdings Inc. ("Corus" or the "Company").

"We are very pleased to complete this Recapitalization Transaction. Our new capital structure provides a platform that positions Corus for new opportunities and future growth," said John Gossling, Corus' Chief Executive Officer.  "As Canada's largest independent broadcaster, we will continue to create and deliver premium content that Canadians want, and we will continue to invest in national and local news that Canadians depend on."

In addition, as contemplated in the Plan, the Company has appointed a new Board of Directors, as follows:

  • Maryann Turcke has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Board of Directors. She is an experienced North American media executive who most recently was Chief Operating Officer of the National Football League, and prior to that was President of Bell Media. Ms. Turcke has deep public board experience, serving on the board of directors of Royal Bank of Canada (TSX:RY) and Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ:SWKS), and also serves as an advisor for a number of private companies in the emerging sport, media, and technology spaces. She has been recognized by Adweek, WXN, and Women in Communications and Technology for her leadership and professional achievements.
  • Stuart Garvie has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Operating Committee. He has held senior leadership roles in media and advertising, including as the former CEO of GroupM (now WPP) Canada, and as the President of media sales and marketing at Bell Media. Mr. Garvie has been involved in a number of media industry organizations, such as Numeris, and provides consulting and leadership services to clients in and around the industry.
  • Erin O'Toole has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Human Resources and Governance Committee. He is currently the President and Managing Director of ADIT North America, and one of Canada's most respected thought leaders on geopolitical and domestic policy issues. He has over a decade of service in the Canadian Parliament, including as Leader of the Official Opposition and as a Cabinet Minister, and currently serves as a member of the Prime Minister's Advisory Council on Canada-U.S. Economic Relations. He was also a commissioned officer in the Royal Canadian Air Force. Mr. O'Toole holds a law degree and has deep public and private company transactional and governance experience.
  • Jeremy Walker has been appointed as a director and Chair of the Audit Committee. He is the former Deputy Chair and Global Head, TD Securities, for the communications, telecommunications and media sectors, where he led a global team providing strategic advice and capital markets execution services to cable, broadcasting, and digital infrastructure companies. In addition to significant financial expertise, Mr. Walker brings nearly 35 years of industry, transactional and strategy experience, as well as governance knowledge, from his service as a director on several non-profit boards and private companies in the health sector.

In addition, John Gossling, Chief Executive Officer and (Interim) Chief Financial Officer of Corus, has been appointed to the Board of Directors. Since joining Corus in 2016, he has provided strategic direction to the Company and brings over 35 years of business experience in the media and communications industries, including at TELUS and Rogers. Mr. Gossling was also a partner at KPMG LLP.

"The new directors and I are excited to join Corus at this important time for the Company and for our industry," said Ms. Turcke, Chair of the Board of Directors. "Our priority is to continue to strengthen Corus' leadership position in Canada by delivering news that Canadians trust and entertainment that Canadians love. We want to build a business that is resilient and will grow into the future, and look forward to working with all of our stakeholders to build a world class, sustainable, and independent media and broadcast industry in Canada, with Corus as a strong and successful player."

"As Canada's largest independent broadcaster, Corus plays a vital role not just in the media industry but also in the fabric of Canadian culture and democracy," added Mr. O'Toole, Chair of the Human Resources and Governance Committee. "Corus creates and delivers independent, high-quality journalism and Canadian programming to millions across the country. I look forward to advancing work to modernize an investment and regulatory ecosystem that truly benefits independent media in Canada."

The Company thanks the prior board of directors for their service. The Company was represented by Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP, Jefferies, and KPMG LLP for legal, transactional, and financial advice, respectively. Canaccord Genuity Corp. acted as financial advisor to the ad hoc group of bondholders. Bennett Jones LLP acted on behalf of the ad hoc group of bondholders and Thornton Grout Finnigan LLP acted on behalf of the lenders under the Company's credit facilities.

Additional information regarding securities and approval

CEI Class B Non-Voting Shares are expected to be delisted from the Toronto Stock Exchange at the close of trading on October 9, 2026 and the new Corus Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares will begin trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange at the market open on October 13, 2026 under the stock ticker "CORS".  As described in the CEI management information circular ("Circular") issued on January 2, 2026 in connection with the Recapitalization Transaction, Corus adopted a capital structure intended to provide for compliance with Canadian ownership requirements under the Broadcasting Act. In connection with the Recapitalization Transaction, Corus applied for and has obtained exemptive relief from the Ontario Securities Commission and other Canadian securities regulators from certain requirements under applicable Canadian securities laws to ensure that the new Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares issued pursuant to the Recapitalization Transaction are treated for these purposes on a combined basis. These include, among others, applicable take-over bid and related early warning reporting requirements under Canadian securities laws. Also, details of delivery of new securities can be found in the Circular (see Issuances and Distributions and Payments to Securityholders).

In light of the fact that it is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, CEI intends to apply to cease to be a reporting issuer under applicable Canadian securities laws.

Pursuant to the decision: (i) for purposes of applicable take-over bid requirements, those requirements would only apply to an offer to acquire 20% or more of the outstanding Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares of Corus on a combined basis, (ii) for purposes of applicable early warning reporting requirements and alternative monthly reporting requirements, those requirements would only apply to an acquirer who acquires or holds beneficial ownership of, or control or direction over, 10% or more of the outstanding Common Voting Shares and Variable Voting Shares of Corus on a combined basis (or 5% in the case of acquisitions during a take-over bid). Corus has also obtained similar relief in respect of any normal course issuer bid. Further, Corus is exempt from certain management information circular disclosure requirements that would require disclosure of 10% shareholders on a class basis, provided that disclosure is made on an aggregate basis.

Details of the exemption will be included in certain of Corus' continuous disclosure documents.

releases.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases Peaches McKnight's Debut Romance Novel Be True to Yourself
releases.body:
The newly published novel from Palmetto Publishing follows eighteen-year-old Mo'Nikko Kohle through a first love complicated by family secrets, divided loyalties and a past that refuses to stay buried.

CHARLESTON, S.C., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Palmetto Publishing has released Be True to Yourself, a novel by Peaches McKnight. The book is a work of romance fiction centered on a young woman's first love and the family and friendships that surround it. It is available now in print and online. McKnight, a Kansas City, Missouri native who now lives in Shawnee Mission, Kansas, writes both fiction and poetry.

The story opens on a Saturday morning. Mo'Nikko Fayon Heaven Kohle, eighteen and in her last month of high school, wants nothing more than her chaise and the paperback love story she is halfway through. Her best friend since kindergarten, Phalisha, has other plans, and they involve the six young men working on a canary yellow 1967 Camaro across the street. One of them catches Nikko by the waist mid fight, calls her Cupcakes, and holds her attention from that moment forward. His name is Ocean.

Nikko is church raised, a virgin by conviction and nobody's easy yes. Ocean is patient, maddening and certain of what he wants. What neither of them can outrun is the life Ocean walked away from, a life that has not finished with him. Closer to home, Nikko's mother Amethyst runs the house with a look that stops a lie in the throat, her sister Kyla sits one bad decision from disaster, and Phalisha keeps a plan tucked behind her smile.

Peaches McKnight stated, "This is a story of love, mystery, murder and loyalty, and I wanted readers to sit with characters who feel like people they already know. Ocean is a loving son and a dedicated partner. Nikko is a loving and all too trusting friend. I hope readers walk away asking who they have been trusting, and whether they have been true to themselves."

Be True to Yourself is written for adult readers of Black urban romance, particularly those drawn to protective heroes, first love heroines and stories where Sunday morning church and criminal history share the same block. Told through multiple points of view, the novel moves between romance, family drama and suspense. Its themes of sisterly rivalry, friendship betrayal and holding to personal conviction under pressure place it alongside contemporary African American romance titles that treat community and consequence as seriously as attraction.

McKnight credits three teachers with putting books in her hands early: Mrs. E. White, Mrs. Tuley and Mrs. Shepherd. She has said the novel exists because those three women got there first.

Be True to Yourself is available for purchase online at Amazon.com and BarnesandNoble.com. For more information about the author, please visit any of their social media platforms.

Instagram: @marilyn330335

TikTok: @marilynmcknight43

About the Author: Three teachers get the credit, and Peaches McKnight names them without hesitation. Mrs. E. White, her English teacher, and Mrs. Tuley, who taught her British literature, put books in her hands at an age when that still changes a person. Mrs. Shepherd believed in her and treated her with kindness from their very first meeting. Be True to Yourself exists because those three women got there first.

Born in Kansas City, Missouri, and a graduate of Southwest High School there, McKnight now lives in Shawnee Mission, Kansas. She writes fiction and poetry, and she reads widely; the romance novels her heroine Nikko hides behind are treated in these pages with affection rather than apology. Travel appeals to her, but so does a gym full of noise on a weeknight, since a good portion of her calendar belongs to her three children and their college basketball games.

Her debut is a story of love, mystery, murder and loyalty, told in the rhythms of real speech, full of banter, eye rolling, and characters who say exactly what they mean the second they think it. Ocean is a loving son and a dedicated partner. Nikko is a loving and all too trusting friend. Denim is loyal and kind hearted. Phalisha is the life of the party, and she knows it. McKnight moves among them in short, quick chapters, and she is unembarrassed by tenderness or by heat.

The book closes with a tribute to mothers, which is where its title finally lands. Be true to yourself is advice Ocean's father gave him as a small child, and McKnight hands it to her readers the same way, plainly, as something worth keeping.

releases.body:
Supercharged hosted Edison, NJ dignitaries at grand opening ceremony

EDISON, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey, the world's largest indoor, multi-level karting track and premier entertainment destination, yesterday launched its newest attraction — Time Mission — a high-energy, immersive adventure where participants race through the past, present, and future to complete a series of interactive challenges. Yesterday's dedicated media day was filled with dignitaries, press, and local influencers an in-depth look at this mind-blowing attraction within Supercharged New Jersey's 125,000-square-foot venue.

Time Mission already thrills guests at venues across Pennsylvania, New York, Rhode Island, Virginia, and Texas, with two more locations coming soon to Chicago and Ohio. The Edison launch marks the brand's first foothold in New Jersey and its latest expansion into what many fans already consider one of the Northeast's premier entertainment destinations, Supercharged Entertainment, located at 987 Route One in Edison.

Within Time Mission, teams of two to five compete across 30+ fast-paced missions – there are no headsets, no controllers, no sitting on the sidelines. Players choose their session length, pick their missions, and dive into a rotating mix of brain-bending puzzles and full-body physical challenges, each lasting just a few minutes to keep the adrenaline pumping. It's the ultimate lineup for birthdays, team outings, field trips, bachelorette parties, corporate events, or any crew ready to settle who's really the best.

Time Mission slots in perfectly alongside Supercharged New Jersey's other incredible attractions: a two-story Arcade & Gaming Area complete with 180+ games and multiple VR experiences, the thrill-a-minute, two-story Drop & Twist Tower, and Burgers and Brews, the venue's full-service restaurant and bar.

"Time Mission completes the loop — we already bring the world's best racing thrills, and now we're adding a one-of-a-kind adventure experience to match," said Cody Browning, Chief Operating Officer, Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey. "This is the missing piece. Supercharged NJ now has something for everyone: couples, families, kids, groups, companies, you name it. New Jersey and New York City are about to find out just how much mind-blowing fun is waiting for them at our Edison location with the addition of Time Mission."

Guests race the clock through a glitch matrix, crack codes, dodge lasers, solve riddles, and uncover hidden tunnels — a mind-bending blend of physical action and mental challenge that keeps every team on their toes from start to finish. As demand for location-based entertainment continues to surge across urban and suburban markets alike, Time Mission gives Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey a dynamic new blend of physical activity, problem-solving, and all-ages fun, reflecting a growing shift toward immersive, connection-driven group experiences.

"Bringing Time Mission to Supercharged Entertainment New Jersey is a great example of how we want to grow: alongside partners who share our obsession with the guest experience," said Pieter Martens, CEO and Founder of Time Mission. "New Jersey is an important market for us, and we're proud to launch with the team at Supercharged that knows how to create something special."

releases.title: KuCoin Launches "Trust, Built-in." Global Brand Initiative with New Film Featuring Adam Scott
releases.body:
Under its enduring "Trust First. Trade Next." proposition, KuCoin introduces a new brand initiative brought to life through KuCoin 5.0--a comprehensive upgrade designed to build trust into every layer of the platform.

PROVIDENCIALES, Turks and Caicos Islands, Oct. 8, 2026 /CNW/ -- KuCoin, a leading global crypto platform built on trust, today launched "Trust, Built-in.", a new global brand initiative under its enduring brand proposition, "Trust First. Trade Next." The launch is accompanied by a new global brand film featuring KuCoin global brand ambassador and major champion Adam Scott, and is brought to life through KuCoin 5.0, a comprehensive upgrade across the platform.

When KuCoin introduced "Trust First. Trade Next.," Scott appeared alongside the company to help establish trust as the principle that comes before every trade, product and decision. His appearance in the new film continues that story. "Trust, Built-in." takes the idea forward by showing how trust can move beyond a guiding principle and become part of the technology, safeguards, tools and experiences that users interact with every day. At the center of the initiative is a simple belief: trust is not claimed; it is built.

KuCoin 5.0 is the product expression of "Trust, Built-in." Rather than a single product update, it represents a platform-wide evolution spanning six dimensions: compliance, technology, asset security, user experience, AI and wealth management.

Together, these upgrades are designed to build trust into every layer of the KuCoin experience:

  • Trust is built into the foundation: stronger technology, asset security, compliance and operational resilience designed to support users over the long term.
  • Trust is built into the experience: a smoother, more consistent experience across devices--simple when users want it, with greater control when they need it.
  • Trust is built for what's next: AI-powered tools, wealth management capabilities and broader opportunities across decentralized and traditional finance, developed around evolving user needs.

Through KuCoin 5.0, users will be able to bring more of their assets together, trade, manage and earn through a more connected experience, and choose how they build their portfolios across devices. The upgrade reflects KuCoin's ambition to create a platform that is not only ready for how users participate today, but built for how digital finance will continue to evolve.

"'Trust First. Trade Next.' remains the long-term brand proposition that defines KuCoin. 'Trust, Built-in.' focuses that commitment on what users should be able to see and experience across the platform," said BC Wong, CEO of KuCoin. "KuCoin 5.0 is how we put that idea into practice. It is not a single product release, but a comprehensive upgrade across the systems, safeguards, tools and experiences that support our users. By building trust into every layer of the platform, we are creating a stronger foundation for how people engage with digital finance today and in the future."

In the new global brand film, Scott draws on the values that have shaped his career--preparation, discipline and consistency--to express why trust must be built through action over time. His role is to bring the initiative's central message to life while continuing the trust story he previously shared with KuCoin.

"Over the course of a long career, you learn that real confidence comes from strong foundations and a commitment to keep improving, even under pressure," said Adam Scott. "What I respect about KuCoin is how it brings that same mindset to the foundation of its platform--building with care, maintaining high standards and creating an experience users can rely on over time. I'm proud to continue this journey with KuCoin."

"Trust, Built-in." will roll out across KuCoin's global communications and market activities alongside KuCoin 5.0. KuCoin will share further details on each of the six upgrade areas in a separate product announcement.

About KuCoin

Founded in 2017, KuCoin is a leading global crypto platform built on trust and security, serving over 45 million users across 200+ countries and regions. Known for its reliability and user-first approach, the platform builds trust into every layer of the user experience, combining advanced technology, deep liquidity, and strong security safeguards to deliver a seamless trading experience. KuCoin provides access to 1,000+ digital assets through a broad product suite and remains committed to building a compliant and user-centric ecosystem for the future of finance, backed by SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701:2019, ISO 22301:2019 and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certifications. In recent years, KuCoin has continued to strengthen its global compliance foundation, marked by key milestones including AUSTRAC registration in Australia, a MiCA license in Europe, and regulatory progress in other markets.

Learn more at www.kucoin.com.

releases.title: Founder-Led Personalized Story Group Acquires International Consumer Publishing Brand, Hooray Heroes
releases.body:
Company expands its personalized publishing platform following consecutive years of triple-digit growth

WILMINGTON, Del. and LJUBLJANA, Slovenia, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Personalized Story Group (PSG) today announced it has acquired Hooray Heroes, an established international personalized-book company that has sold more than three million personalized books to customers worldwide.

The acquisition represents the latest step in PSG's strategy to build a global portfolio of personalized publishing and gifting brands supported by shared technology, product development, marketing and fulfilment infrastructure.

Hooray Heroes will join PSG's existing portfolio of Story Bug, My Story Tale and Wall Art Prints. The transaction is PSG's second brand acquisition and expands the group's international customer base, publishing catalogue and capabilities in multi-character and family-focused personalization.

PSG has recorded consecutive years of triple-digit growth while maintaining profitability without institutional funding by using a disciplined focus on customer experience, product quality, and operational efficiency, supported by continued investment in the group's personalized technology platform.

"Hooray Heroes is a highly recognized international brand with an extensive creative catalogue, a loyal customer base and more than a decade of experience in personalized publishing," said Brendon Watson, CEO of Personalized Story Group. "This acquisition is a strong strategic fit for PSG as it gives Hooray Heroes access to our technology, marketing and operating capabilities, while allowing the brand to retain the identity and customer proposition that made it successful." said Watson.

Founded in Slovenia in 2013 with an international customer base across the US, Europe and other global markets, Hooray Heroes developed into one of the personalized-book category's most established independent brands. Its catalogue includes illustrated personalized books featuring children, parents, grandparents, couples, siblings and pets across birthdays, holidays and other milestone occasions.

"From the beginning, our objective was to build a brand that helped families celebrate the relationships that matter most," said Rado Daradan, co-founder and former CEO of Hooray Heroes. "PSG understands both the creative and commercial requirements of personalized publishing; its technology, operating capabilities and commitment to preserving the Hooray Heroes brand make it the right owner to support the next phase of the company's development," Daradan added.

Hooray Heroes will continue operating under its existing brand name. PSG expects to migrate the brand onto its shared technology and operating platform within two weeks of completion, reflecting the group's established ability to rapidly integrate acquired businesses.

PSG will continue evaluating complementary acquisition opportunities involving established consumer brands that can benefit from its technology, ecommerce, performance marketing and international fulfilment capabilities.

Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

About Personalized Story Group (PSG)

Founded in 2023, Personalized Story Group is a technology-enabled personalized publishing and gifting company operating Story Bug, My Story Tale, Wall Art Prints and Hooray Heroes. Its brands create personalized children's books, adult books, family gifts and custom wall art for customers across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, New Zealand and other international markets. For more information, visit https://personalizedstorygroup.com/

releases.title: Capacity LLC Acquires UK-Based Core Fulfilment, Creating a Single Fulfillment Partner for Consumer Brands Expanding Across the US and UK
releases.body:
Key Takeaways:

  • Capacity LLC has acquired a majority stake in Core Fulfilment, a UK-based ecommerce fulfillment provider serving consumer brands across personal care, household goods and other fast-growing categories, creating one fulfillment partner operating across both the U.S. and UK.
  • The deal gives U.S. brands a consistent foothold in the UK, helping them manage the cost of shipping to UK customers and the fast delivery those customers expect.
  • Core Fulfilment customers gain access to Capacity's warehouse technology and engineering-led operations, while the combined company's greater scale strengthens carrier leverage for both sides amid rising cross-border logistics costs.

NORTH BRUNSWICK, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Capacity LLC, a fulfillment provider specializing in beauty, fragrance, wellness and other fast-growing consumer product companies, today announced it has acquired a majority stake in Core Fulfilment, a UK-based ecommerce fulfillment company with more than 15 years of experience serving consumer brands across personal care, household goods and other categories. The acquisition creates a single fulfillment partner operating in both the U.S. and UK.

The announcement comes as cross-border fulfillment has grown more operationally complex for consumer brands, with rising shipping costs and shrinking delivery windows making international growth harder to execute without the right infrastructure in place. For brands shipping orders to UK customers from the US, longer delivery times can be a disadvantage in a market where consumers expect things fast. By combining Capacity's beauty-industry expertise, management, technology and infrastructure with Core Fulfilment's UK operational knowledge, the acquisition gives Capacity's existing customers a faster, more cost-efficient way to reach consumers on both sides of the Atlantic. Brands no longer have to rebuild logistics infrastructure from scratch in a market where speed and cost have become increasingly difficult to manage.

"This is about building the unified fulfillment operation brands will need for the next phase of their growth," said Jeff Kaiden, CEO of Capacity. "As consumer brands expand across channels and borders, they need partners that can enable them to enter new markets without added complexity."

What does this mean for customers? Capacity's U.S.-based brands expanding into the UK now gain immediate access to Core's established operation and existing carrier relationships. Core Fulfilment's customers, in turn, gain access to systems built to manage promotional spikes and seasonality, along with Capacity's engineering-led approach to continuous improvement, including throughput analysis and pick-route optimization. For UK beauty and fragrance brands looking to expand into the U.S., the combination also adds a capability few partners can offer: Capacity's DOT-SP 21015 hazmat permit, one of only 31 held by fulfillment providers in the U.S., which allows regulated products like fragrance and aerosols to move through the U.S. market as brands scale.

"Our customers have grown alongside us for years, and the question they always come back to is 'what comes next,'" said Paul Burns, co-founder of Core Fulfilment. "Partnering with Capacity means we can answer that with technology, engineering resources and scale that would have taken us much longer to build on our own."

Moving Forward. This marks a strategic milestone for Capacity as it expands its footprint through an established UK operation and local leadership team. Core Fulfilment will continue to operate from its existing UK sites under its current leadership; there will be no immediate changes to customer accounts, service teams or day-to-day operations. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

"This acquisition is a first for Capacity, giving us immediate network expansion in the UK with an established operating team with deep local market knowledge," said Jocelyn Petersen, CFO of Capacity. "Bringing our technology and operations together is expected to strengthen fulfillment services and add value for customers in both the U.S. and UK markets."

About Capacity

Capacity LLC is a third-party logistics provider specializing in fulfillment for beauty, wellness, and fragrance brands. Founded in 1999, the privately owned company operates facilities in New Jersey, California, and Indiana, with UK operations through partners in Cheshire and European fulfillment support through its partner Widem in Belgium. Capacity combines operational expertise with modern technology to help brands scale fulfillment across retail and direct-to-consumer channels.

About Core Fulfilment

Core Fulfilment is a specialist ecommerce order fulfilment provider based in Crewe, Cheshire, England. The company serves direct-to-consumer brands across fashion, fitness, health and beauty, and pet products, offering multichannel fulfilment with integrations to major platforms.

releases.title: Canela Media Brings Its Six Hispanic Culture Cohorts to Life with New Audience Segments Available Through Canela Audience Solutions
releases.body:
New audience segments allow marketers to reach Hispanic consumers based on cultural identity, behaviors and affinity

NEW YORK, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Canela Media, a leading technology and innovation multicultural media company, today announced that its proprietary Hispanic Culture Cohorts are now available as targetable audience segments through Canela Audience Solutions. Marketers can activate the segments directly with Canela Media or through the major DSPs and SSPs they already use, giving them a new way to reach U.S. Hispanic consumers based on how they live, express and navigate their culture.

The segments build on Canela Media's Hispanic Culture Cohorts Study, released in August, which identified six cohorts defined by how people live, express and navigate their culture. To create the segments, Canela matched each cohort's demographic and behavioral profile to its Canela Audience Solutions data. This lets marketers move from the study's insights to activating them in campaigns.

"Reaching Hispanic consumers isn't about picking one audience and one message," said Paula Baldwin, VP of Brand Partnerships at Canela Media. "The real opportunity is in how you use the cohorts together, with different creative environments and timing for each, all within the same campaign."

The six cohorts, their share of study respondents, and the segment names marketers will find in each platform:

  • Cultural Preservers (27%), available as Canela Media Preservers — Highly expressive and deeply rooted in their heritage, with content serving as a way to preserve and celebrate culture. 94% feel a responsibility to preserve and pass on their culture.
  • Cultural Navigators (20%), available as Canela Media Navigators — Internally anchored and increasingly bilingual, moving comfortably between cultures on their own terms. 92% say they move easily between cultures.
  • Cultural Remixers (17%), available as Canela Media Remixers — Deliberately bicultural, connecting two worlds and code-switching with intention. 98% identify as both American and Hispanic/Latino.
  • Culturally Fluid (15%), available as Canela Media Fluid — Effortlessly bicultural, moving between cultures as a natural part of everyday life and scoring highest on bicultural measures.
  • Culturally Adjacent (12%), available as Canela Media Adjacent — Engaging with culture selectively through influences such as music, food and aesthetics, with 58% remaining proud of their heritage.
  • Cultural Reactors (9%), available as Canela Media Reactors — Carrying cultural connection through memory, nostalgia and emotional familiarity, creating opportunities for brands to re-engage cultural affinity.

Whether buying direct with Canela Media or programmatically, marketers can now select the cohort, or combination of cohorts, that best aligns with a campaign's objectives. All six segments can be found under the Canela Media name in each platform. The offering enables brands to develop more intentional strategies around three broad approaches identified by Canela's research:

  • SERVE: Connect with Cultural Preservers and Culturally Fluid audiences through culturally rooted content that celebrates identity and representation.
  • ENGAGE: Reach Cultural Navigators and Cultural Remixers with timely, shareable and expressive content that participates in the cultural conversation.
  • RECONNECT: Reconnect with Culturally Adjacent and Cultural Reactors through emotional triggers such as nostalgia, family, community and familiarity.

"Now marketers can decide not just who to reach, but how and when," Baldwin added. "They can serve heritage-driven creative to Cultural Preservers, put timely, shareable content in front of Remixers and Navigators, and reach Culturally Adjacent audiences and Cultural Reactors in the moments when nostalgia hits hardest."

The Culture Cohorts segments add a new dimension to Canela Audience Solutions, which already moves beyond standard demographic definitions by incorporating cultural nuance, content consumption patterns and behavioral insights. With the cohorts, brands can now plan around how their audiences relate to culture, not just who they are or what they watch.

The Culture Cohorts Study was conducted in May 2026 among 1,975 respondents and is proprietary research from Canela Media. The full report is available here for free download, and the white paper Canela Media's Hispanic Cultural Cohorts Study: How Culture, Content and Identity Shape Hispanic Brand Connection, published with Ad Age on September 15, is available here.

About Canela Media

Canela Media is an innovation and technology-driven media company connecting brands with U.S. Hispanic audiences through a portfolio of streaming, content, data, creative and audience engagement solutions. Its ecosystem includes Canela.TV, Canela Audience Solutions, Canela Studios and Club Canela, giving marketers multiple ways to reach and engage Hispanic audiences with scale, relevance and precision across and beyond Canela's platforms.

For more information, visit: https://www.CanelaMedia.com

releases.title: The House of Suntory's Yamazaki 25 Years Old Awarded Trophy in the Japanese Whisky Category at International Spirits Challenge 2026 and Suntory Spirits Named Japanese Whisky Producer of the Year
releases.body:
This marks the fourth consecutive year Yamazaki has earned a Trophy in the Japanese Whisky category

NEW YORK, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Suntory Global Spirits, a world leader in premium spirits, today announced that The House of Suntory's Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky 25 Years Old has been awarded a Trophy at the International Spirits Challenge (ISC) 2026, the competition's highest honor in the Japanese Whisky category. The award marks the fourth consecutive year a Yamazaki whisky has received this accolade.

Why is Yamazaki 25 Years Old's International Spirits Challenge 2026 win significant?

  • This latest achievement marks the fourth consecutive year that Yamazaki has earned the competition's honor in the Japanese Whisky category: Yamazaki 25 Years Old in 2023, Yamazaki 12 Years Old in 2024, and Yamazaki 18 Years Old in 2025.
  • This achievement reinforces Yamazaki's position among the world's premier spirits and underscores Suntory Global Spirits' leadership in exceptional whisky.
  • The recognition also reinforces the importance of upholding the Japanese Whisky standards set by the Japan Spirits & Liqueurs Makers Association, standards that help protect the authenticity, heritage and craftsmanship behind the category. As the association's logo begins to roll out across The House of Suntory's authentic Japanese Whisky products, consumers will have an easier way to identify whiskies that meet these standards.

"Yamazaki 25 Years Old was first introduced in 1999, and in 2021 we evolved the whisky to more intentionally express Tsukuriwake — the diversity of our whisky‑making — and Tsukurikomi — the refinement and mastery behind our craft." said Suntory Chief Blender, Shinji Fukuyo. "Seeing Yamazaki 25 Years Old receive this prestigious recognition today is profoundly meaningful for our entire team. It affirms the continuity of our craftsmanship across generations and our unwavering commitment to creating whiskies that honor Yamazaki's legacy while continuing to evolve."

What is the International Spirits Challenge and how are its awards judged?

The International Spirits Challenge is one of the industry's most prestigious competitions, judged by a panel of world-renowned experts who assess spirits for quality, balance, and character.

International Spirits Challenge judges noted: "There's a reason Yamazaki is so widely accepted as a global benchmark in quality whisky. The combination of texture and fruitiness, the multiple layers - it has everything happening within it to make me want just a little bit more."

What does Yamazaki 25 Years Old taste like?

  • Color: Amber
  • Nose: Mizunara smoky notes of incense, followed by a complex bouquet of mature kaki persimmon and ume plum notes.
  • Palate: A smoky first sip of Mizunara sandalwood notes that open and deepen into complex layers of kaki persimmon subtle sweetness, tart ume plum notes and gentle shoga ginger spicy notes.
  • Finish: Profound long finish with Mizunara smokiness and lingering subtly sweet wood notes that remain.

What other notable awards did The House of Suntory win?

  • In addition to this top accolade, Hakushu 18 Years Old Peated Malt and Hakushu 25 Years Old each earned Double Gold medals, further underscoring the exceptional quality and strength of The House of Suntory portfolio.
  • Suntory Spirits also earned recognition as Producer of the Year in the Japanese Whisky category for the seventh consecutive year.
  • All other awards can be seen below:

  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky 25 Years Old

  • The Hakushu Single Malt Whisky 25 Years Old

  • The Hakushu Single Malt Whisky Japanese Forest Bittersweet Edition
  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Whisky
  • The Yamazaki Single Malt Japanese Whisky Mizunara Japanese Oak Cask 25 Years Old

About The House of Suntory 

Suntory is renowned as the founding house of Japanese Whisky, beginning with Shinjiro Torii's creation of Japan's first malt whisky distillery in Yamazaki in 1923 and carried forward by his son, Keizo Saji, founder of the Hakushu and Chita Distillery. As the generations of Suntory's master blenders carry on, Suntory Whisky remains committed to heritage and innovation.

Today, the House of Suntory continues to craft award-winning spirits, including Yamazaki®, Hakushu®, Chita®, Kakubin®, Hibiki®, and Suntory Whisky Toki™. All 100% distilled, matured, and bottled in Japan, in full compliance with the Japan Spirits & Liqueurs Makers Association (JSLMA) standards. The House of Suntory also includes Roku™ Japanese Gin, Haku™ Japanese Vodka, and Kanáde Japanese Liqueur, reflecting the same dedication to craftsmanship, quality, and innovation that have defined Suntory for over a century.

In 2025, Yamazaki® made history at the International Spirits Challenge as the first brand to win Supreme Champion Spirit three years in a row, and in 2024, Chief Blender Shinji Fukuyo was named Master Blender of the Year. Furthering this legacy of excellence, the Osaka Spirits & Liqueurs Craft Distillery, home to Roku Gin, Haku Vodka and Kanáde Japanese Liqueur was awarded the 2025 Liqueur Producer Trophy by the International Wine & Spirit Competition (IWSC). The House of Suntory will open the Osaka Craft Distillery to the public for the first time in 2026.

About Suntory Global Spirits 

As a world leader in premium spirits, Suntory Global Spirits inspires the brilliance of life, by creating rich experiences for people, in harmony with nature. Known for its craftsmanship of premium American whiskeys, including Jim Beam® and Maker's Mark®; Japanese whiskies, including Yamazaki® and Hibiki®; and leading Scotch brands including Laphroaig®, Suntory Global Spirits also produces leading brands such as El Tesoro® and Hornitos® tequilas and Roku® gin, and is a world leader in Ready-To-Drink cocktails, with brands like -196™ (minus one-nine-six) and On The Rocks™ Bartender Created Cocktails.

A global company with approximately 6,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, Suntory Global Spirits is driven by its core values of Growing for Good, Yatte Minahare and Giving Back to Society, and aims to have a positive impact on the planet, consumers and communities. Headquartered in New York City, Suntory Global Spirits is a subsidiary of Suntory Holdings Limited of Japan. For more information, visit www.suntoryglobalspirits.com and www.drinksmart.com.

releases.title: OptiSigns Expands Secure TV Dashboard Apps for Power BI, Salesforce, Tableau, Grafana, Databricks and More
releases.body:
Secure, centrally managed dashboard apps bring business data to the TVs teams already look at.

HOUSTON, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OptiSigns, a digital signage company powering more than 200,000 screens worldwide, today announced expanded and enhanced dashboard apps, which now work with Microsoft Power BI, Salesforce, Tableau, Grafana, Databricks and more. Businesses can now show automatically updating  live dashboards on TV screens in offices, factories and operations centers.

Companies spend more than $70 billion a year on business intelligence software, according to HG Insights, yet research from BARC and Eckerson Group found only about a quarter of employees actively use BI tools. A 2016 meta-analysis of 138 studies published in Psychological Bulletin found that monitoring progress helps people achieve their goals, with greater benefits when progress is recorded or shared publicly. Getting dashboards onto shared screens can mean relying on manual screenshots, leaving account credentials on devices or publishing sensitive reports publicly.

With OptiSigns, companies connect their dashboard accounts once, pick a dashboard and assign it to one screen or many. The apps work with cloud and self-hosted platforms, personal or company accounts, and any number of teams. In Power BI, a single report can also show each location its own figures. For example, a retailer can use screen-specific filters to display each store's sales figures while managing one report centrally.

Dashboards rotate in playlists, run on schedules or share a split screen like any other OptiSigns content. Screens never hold the account's password or long-lived secrets, which stay encrypted on OptiSigns' servers.

"When the numbers are on the wall, everyone sees the same picture at the same time," said Henry Le, chief executive officer at OptiSigns. "Companies put real money into their dashboards, and then those dashboards sit on a few laptops. We made it simple to get that information in front of the whole team."

Dashboard apps are available today on the Pro Plus plan and higher. Plans start at $10 per screen per month. For more information, visit optisigns.com.

About OptiSigns

OptiSigns is a Houston, Texas-based digital signage company that helps more than 36,000 businesses run content across over 200,000 screens worldwide. Its catalog of 160+ apps turns any TV into a live display for menus, schedules, social feeds and dashboards. Learn more at optisigns.com.

releases.title: Formula 1® on Apple TV to Debut in Dolby Atmos, Alongside Dolby Vision, Delivering a More Immersive Race Experience
releases.body:
Experience every turn, overtake, and roar of the track with stunning picture and immersive sound, beginning with the Formula 1® MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix™ 2026

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Dolby Laboratories (NYSE: DLB) and Apple announced that Dolby Atmos is coming to Formula 1® on Apple TV1 beginning with the 2026 U.S. Grand Prix™, joining Dolby Vision to deliver an even more immersive viewing experience. For the first time, fans in the U.S. with an Apple TV subscription will be able to experience every Formula 1 race weekend in both Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos.

Dolby Atmos puts fans at the heart of the action, surrounding them with the energy, drama, and emotion of Formula 1. From team radio communications and race commentary to the roar of the engines, on-track battles, and the intensity of the pit lane, Dolby Atmos brings the unmistakable sounds that define the sport to life.

Paired with Dolby Vision, fans can take in every detail of race weekend through richer colors, greater contrast, enhanced brightness, and lifelike clarity. From the vibrant liveries of each team to the atmosphere and character of Formula 1's most iconic circuits, Dolby Vision is the ultimate complement to the spectacular visuals that define Formula 1. Together, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos deliver a more immersive Formula 1 experience, bringing exceptional picture and sound together to capture the full intensity of the sport.

Formula 1 in Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos is available through the Apple TV app on supported Apple devices and compatible Dolby-enabled TVs, soundbars, and home theater systems.

"Formula 1 is one of the most captivating sports in the world, where every circuit, team, and race weekend has its own visual and sonic identity," said John Couling, Senior Vice President of Entertainment, Dolby Laboratories. "Together, Dolby and Apple have redefined how audiences experience entertainment, from music to movies and TV. Now, with Dolby Atmos joining Dolby Vision for Formula 1 on Apple TV, we're setting a new bar for how fans experience the sights and sounds of the sport."

"We're always looking for new ways to make Formula 1 on Apple TV even better for fans," said Oliver Schusser, Apple's vice president of Music, Sports, Apple TV, and Beats. "The sound of Formula 1 is such an important part of what makes the sport so exciting, and with Dolby Atmos joining Dolby Vision, fans can experience the energy and intensity of every Grand Prix in a whole new way. It's another example of how we're continuing to innovate across the viewing experience to bring fans closer to the action."

For decades, Dolby has brought fans closer to the sports they love through innovations that make every moment more immersive and engaging. By capturing the emotion, excitement, and intensity of the action, Dolby helps recreate the feeling of being at a race. With Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, Formula 1 on Apple TV delivers an even more immersive race weekend, bringing the sights and sounds of the track to life in a whole new way.

Apple TV is the exclusive U.S. home of Formula 1, delivering every practice, qualifying, Sprint session, and race live and on demand. Subscribers get comprehensive coverage and analysis, expansive programming, exclusive original content, and every Grand Prix in stunning 4K with Dolby Vision, which launched at the start of the season. Viewers can also personalize how they follow the action with Multiview, including one-tap team layouts featuring the main broadcast and onboard feeds, as well as dedicated Podium and Data Multiviews with real-time race information. Fans can learn more about Formula 1 on Apple TV and subscribe HERE.

Experience Formula 1 in Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision for the first time with the 2026 U.S. Grand Prix beginning Friday, October 23, exclusively on Apple TV.

releases.body:
Partnership combines Get Engaged's deep U.S. relationships and culture-driven expertise with SAMY's global social-first scale and data, strategy and creative capabilities.

NEW YORK, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Get Engaged, a leading U.S. social-first agency specializing in creators, talent, entertainment and culture, today announced that it is joining SAMY, a global independent social-first agency. The combination brings together two social specialists to create one of the largest independent social-first influencer/creator agencies in the world, expanding the capabilities both organizations can offer brands globally.

For Get Engaged clients, the combination provides access to greater global reach and international activation capabilities, complemented by deeper social-first expertise across data and insights, strategy, creative, content production, social commerce, and product and technology development. At the same time, Get Engaged will retain its founders, leadership, culture, client-first approach and hands-on service model.

Alex Dermer, CEO of Get Engaged said, "We built Get Engaged to help brands connect with culture in ways that move their businesses forward. Joining SAMY gives us the global reach, technology and talent to take that vision further. What excites me most is our shared ambition for where this industry is going and the role we can play in shaping it. As I step into the CEO role of Get Engaged, I'm proud of what we've built and energized by what this partnership makes possible for our clients and our team."

"The next era of marketing will belong to brands that create moments people want to be part of. We see a huge opportunity to bring brands, creators and talent together in ways that go well beyond a single campaign. releases.title: Personalized Story Group Acquires Hooray Heroes, Expanding Its Global Personalized Publishing Portfolio
releases.body:
Acquisition brings one of the personalized-book category's most established independent brands into its growing publishing group

WILMINGTON, Del. and LJUBLJANA, Slovenia, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Personalized Story Group (PSG) today announced that it has acquired Hooray Heroes, the established international personalized book publisher known for creating illustrated stories featuring children, parents, grandparents, siblings and pets.

Founded in Slovenia in 2013, Hooray Heroes has grown into an internationally recognised personalized publishing brand, serving customers across the United States, Europe, Australia, and other global markets. Its extensive catalogue includes books for birthdays, holidays, new babies, family milestones, and other meaningful occasions, with more than three million personalized books created for customers worldwide.

Hooray Heroes joins Personalized Story Group's growing portfolio of publishing and gifting brands, which includes Story Bug, My Story Tale, and Wall Art Prints. The acquisition significantly expands the group's creative catalogue, international customer base and capabilities in multi-character and family-focused product personalization.

"Hooray Heroes has built an outstanding publishing brand with a loyal global audience and a catalogue that has helped millions of families see themselves represented in the stories they share," said Brendon Watson, CEO of Personalized Story Group.

"Its strength in family-focused and multi-character storytelling is highly complementary to the books we have developed through Story Bug and My Story Tale. We see an exciting opportunity to preserve what customers already love about Hooray Heroes, while investing in new stories, enhanced personalization, and the brand's next stage of international growth."

Personalized Story Group has recorded its second consecutive year of triple-digit growth as market demand continues to increase for highly personalized books and gifts. The addition of Hooray Heroes forms part of PSG's strategy to build a leading independent global group of personalized publishing brands, while allowing each brand to retain its own creative identity and customer proposition.

"From the beginning, our goal was to create books that made children and families feel seen, celebrated and connected," said Rado Daradan, co-founder and former CEO of Hooray Heroes.

"Personalized Story Group understands both the creative and technological sides of personalized publishing. Its commitment to preserving the Hooray Heroes brand, combined with its publishing capabilities and international reach, makes PSG the right home for the company's next chapter."

Hooray Heroes will continue operating under its existing brand name. Personalized Story Group plans to invest in the development of new titles, expanded personalization capabilities and the continued international growth of the brand.

Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

About Personalized Story Group (PSG)

Founded in year 2023, Personalized Story Group is a technology-enabled personalized publishing and gifting company operating Story Bug, My Story Tale, Wall Art Prints and Hooray Heroes. Its brands create personalized children's books, adult books, family gifts, and custom wall art for customers across the United States, UK, Australia, and other international markets.

The group operates a shared technology, publishing and fulfilment platform designed to support rapid product development, international growth, and the integration of complementary consumer brands.

releases.title: TrackVia Government Achieves FedRAMP® Class C Certification, Expanding Secure Mission Operations for Federal Agencies and Contractors
releases.body:
Certification through Second Front Systems brings TrackVia's Field Operations Intelligence platform into secure government environments where workforce readiness, program execution and mission delivery depend on speed and trust

DENVER, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TrackVia today announced that TrackVia Government, the field operations intelligence platform built for federal, state, and local agencies, has achieved FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) Certification through the 2F Game Warden® Platform, expanding TrackVia's ability to support U.S. government organizations and contractors operating in secure, mission-critical environments. 

Government missions depend on thousands of operational processes that have to work every day, managing personnel and readiness, coordinating projects and programs, tracking resources, supporting field teams, exchanging information with contractors and partners, and ensuring work moves securely across organizations. Those processes are often fragmented across legacy systems, spreadsheets, email and disconnected applications.

Agencies cannot simply replace the systems they already depend on. The federal government spends more than $100 billion annually on IT and cyber-related investments, with agencies historically reporting that roughly 80% goes to operations and maintenance of existing IT, including legacy systems, according to the U.S. Government Accountability Office.

Now, TrackVia Government gives agencies and contractors a different path, modernizing the operational layer around the systems they already rely on, without requiring replacement of core infrastructure. TrackVia helps organizations connect the people doing the work, the workflows that execute the mission and the operational data leaders need to make decisions, now within a FedRAMP-certified environment designed for secure government use.

"Government organizations shouldn't have to choose between speed and security," said Aylin Basom, Chief Executive Officer of TrackVia. "The work our customers run on TrackVia can be directly connected to workforce readiness, program execution, field operations and mission delivery. That work has to move quickly, but it also has to meet the security and governance standards the government requires. FedRAMP Certification allows us to bring the flexibility and speed TrackVia is known for into environments where trust and security are non-negotiable. Agencies and contractors can modernize critical operational workflows, connect existing systems and give teams better visibility into the work, without having to rebuild everything from scratch."

TrackVia Government runs on Second Front Systems' Game Warden, a pre-accredited DevSecOps platform designed to accelerate the deployment of commercial software into government environments while providing inherited security controls and continuous monitoring TrackVia has been listed in the FedRAMP Marketplace under the TrackVia Government listing.

"Agencies aren't going to decommission core infrastructure, and the best commercial software doesn't ask them to," said Nick Woodruff, General Manager, North America at Second Front Systems. "TrackVia now has its own FedRAMP listing, and our teams worked side by side to bring it into an accredited environment that preserved its flexibility and kept it working with the systems agencies already run. Our partnership goes well beyond the platform, from the accredited environment to how we take it to agencies together."

Built for the Work Behind the Mission

Government operations rarely fit neatly into a single off the shelf application. TrackVia Government can support operational use cases such as:

  • Workforce readiness, personnel coordination and resource management
  • Program and project execution
  • Field operations and inspections
  • Contractor and subcontractor coordination
  • Secure collection and exchange of operational information
  • Compliance and audit workflows
  • Asset, site and logistics management
  • Mission support processes spanning multiple teams and systems

Because TrackVia is configurable, organizations can adapt workflows as mission requirements, teams and operating conditions change, without relying on lengthy custom software development cycles.

"The opportunity for us is much bigger than digitizing forms or replacing spreadsheets," Basom said. "We want TrackVia Government to become the operational layer that helps agencies and contractors coordinate mission-critical work, understand what is happening across their operations and act faster when conditions change."

About TrackVia

TrackVia is a Field Operations Intelligence platform that helps organizations connect, control, and continuously improve mission-critical operations. TrackVia brings together field teams, operational workflows and enterprise data to create real time visibility, automate work and turn operational data into actionable intelligence. TrackVia Government, the company's FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) Certified environment, extends that platform to federal, state, and local government customers. To learn more, visit trackvia.com.

About Second Front Systems

Second Front Systems (2F) is a public-benefit software company powering software for the free world. We eliminate the friction that slows innovation, enabling faster, more secure development and deployment of software across government and regulated networks. Built by national security veterans and backed by top-tier venture capital, our platform is trusted by the world's leading organizations to cut deployment timelines from years to weeks. We move fast, solve hard problems, and deliver trusted capabilities where they're needed most. Our work strengthens global security and gives the United States and its allies a lasting competitive advantage. Learn more at secondfront.com.
