releases.title: WZC Networking Marks 20 Years of Engineering Emergency Responder Radio Coverage
releases.body:
NOVI, Mich., Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WZC Networking marks its 20th anniversary this year, reflecting two decades of designing, installing, and testing the in-building radio systems that keep firefighters and EMS crews connected when they move inside a structure. When a radio goes silent inside a building, a crew loses contact with command at the moment communication matters most. That's the gap WZC was built to close.

In 2006, RF engineer John Wierzgac founded WZC around an uncomplicated truth: concrete and steel might block a fire, but they shouldn't choke out a distress call. Twenty years later, WZC has become Michigan's benchmark for Emergency Responder Communication Enhancement Systems (ERCES) and Public Safety DAS. We don't sit back and wait for signal drops to expose a blind spot. Instead, we pull up a chair with developers, fire chiefs, and inspectors long before the first antenna hits the roof, wiring absolute reliability directly into the blueprint.

Buildings have radically evolved since 2006. Thick concrete and low-E glass save energy, but they block radio signals, creating dead zones in stairwells, basements, and interior corridors where portable radios lose contact with the outside. Where a building cannot meet the coverage thresholds required under NFPA 1225 and IFC Section 510, as adopted locally, an ERCES is required. WZC treats that coverage as a life-safety system rather than a permit item, and looks for blind spots in design rather than at the certificate-of-occupancy inspection.

A Building Days from Opening, and a Signal That Wasn't There

Days before the Corewell Health Endoscopy Center was set to open, acceptance testing identified insufficient in-building radio coverage, putting the fire marshal's sign-off and the facility's certificate of occupancy at risk with a fixed opening date approaching.

The Christman Group brought in WZC Networking. The team designed a compliant solution, expedited equipment procurement, and produced documented test results that satisfied the fire marshal and supported the issuance of a temporary certificate of occupancy, allowing the facility to open on schedule while the permanent system was completed.

It's the kind of save that never makes headlines because it isn't supposed to happen at all. A healthcare facility opened on time. A general contractor learned who to call before groundbreaking on the next project, not after a failed test threatens the finish line. That's why Christman looks to WZC first now: not because of a sales pitch, but because the work held up when the schedule had no room left.

Fifty-One Percent, Not Even Close to Enough

At Clawson Manor Co-op, a 15-story senior living complex, energy-efficient glazing and heavy exterior cladding were severely attenuating public safety radio frequencies. A WZC Networking survey found that only 51 percent of the property met required signal thresholds. In the egress corridors, where reliable communication is critical during an emergency, that figure dropped to just 34 percent. For hundreds of elderly residents who cannot evacuate rapidly during a crisis, those gaps could have left arriving crews without reliable communications.

WZC engineered and installed a signal booster and distributed antenna system sized for the building's envelope. On re-test, the property passed in 100 percent of tested grid areas, exceeding the thresholds required under NFPA 1225 and IFC Section 510 as adopted locally. Clawson Fire Department Battalion Chief and Fire Marshal John Ruthenbeck noted, "The City of Clawson was more than satisfied with the design and installation of the system by WZC Networking and the professional service provided to both the residents of the Clawson Manor and the Clawson Fire/Police and EMS Agencies."

Nobody on the Other End of That Radio Is Replaceable

Behind each of these projects are people who aren't statistics. At Clawson Manor, there are several hundred residents who cannot evacuate quickly on their own. At Corewell Health, there are patients under sedation and the staff responsible for getting them out.

When fire marshals deny an occupancy permit, the code is not the end goal. Protecting the people inside the building is. WZC operates on one inviolable principle: no contractor's deadline and no construction budget is worth a human life. A wall should only ever shelter people, never cut them off from the communication that could save them.

Passing Once Is Not Compliance

WZC makes one point clear to owners and facility managers: an ERCES is not finished at commissioning. NFPA 1225 requires ongoing inspection and testing of these systems, covering donor signal, amplifier gain, alarm reporting, and battery backup performance, along with periodic verification of in-building coverage. Buildings and the RF environment around them change over time, and a system that passed when it was commissioned may not perform the same way years later. Responsibility for maintaining that compliance sits with the building owner.

In practice, a system that passed at turnover and has not been touched in four years is a system nobody can vouch for. WZC provides ongoing ERCES inspection, testing, and documentation programs so owners maintain current, AHJ-ready records rather than discovering a lapse during an inspection or, worse, during an incident.

Twenty Years, One Principle

Earlier this year, WZC hosted fire chiefs and fire marshals for an open workshop on ERCES field conditions, focused on education rather than a product pitch. "Twenty years in, it still comes down to the same thing," says founder John Wierzgac. "A radio has to work on every floor and in every stairwell, not just in the lobby. If it doesn't, the system isn't finished, whether or not anyone is inspecting it that day."

That principle drives every project WZC takes on, from healthcare clinics to senior living centers. First responders don't view emergency communication as code compliance; they see equipment they have to be able to depend on. That focus has not changed as WZC has expanded. "Most of the buildings we walk into were never designed with radio coverage in mind," says Nate Wierzgac, Chief Operating Officer. "Nobody asks the question early, so it surfaces at the end, when it is expensive to fix. We would rather be in that conversation during design, and we would rather owners know the testing obligation doesn't stop at turnover."

From a Novi startup to a multi-state partner, WZC Networking has built its practice one building, one grid test, and one clear channel at a time, so that when the call comes, it carries.

WZC Networking is an RF engineering and technology integration firm founded in 2006 in Novi, Michigan. WZC designs, installs, tests, and maintains Emergency Responder Communication Enhancement Systems (ERCES), public safety and cellular DAS, structured cabling, Wi-Fi, security and CCTV, and audiovisual systems. The company also delivers ongoing managed and compliance services for multi-site clients across the United States.

Learn more at https://www.wzcnetworking.com

releases.title: Tanya Zuckerbrot, Founder of F-Factor, Resolves Lawsuit Against Emily Gellis After Six Years of Litigation
releases.body:
Settlement Includes $240,000 Payment and Public Video Apology to Remain Pinned on Gellis' Social Media Profile for Three and a Half Years

NEW YORK, Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tanya Zuckerbrot, MS, RD, founder of F-Factor, has resolved her defamation and cyberstalking lawsuit against fashion influencer Emily Gellis after six years of litigation. As part of the settlement, Gellis is publishing a public video apology on her Instagram account, acknowledging that the allegations she promoted were not supported by verified evidence.

"I spent 25 years building my career and F-Factor, only to watch a smear campaign built on lies destroy my company within months," said Zuckerbrot. "While I was fighting to save everything I had worked for, I was also enduring relentless cyberstalking and harassment that reached into my home and my family's life. An apology cannot undo that damage or give us back those years, but this settlement represents accountability. Now, I'm focused on rebuilding F-Factor, returning to the work I love and reclaiming the future I worked so hard to create."

Under the settlement, Gellis agreed to pay Zuckerbrot $240,000 in monthly installments of $500 over 40 years. The payment represents reimbursement for the costs of trauma treatment Zuckerbrot underwent as a result of the campaign. The settlement also requires Gellis to publish a video apology on her social media and keep it pinned to the top of her profile for three and a half years, ensuring it remains prominently visible to visitors.

The lawsuit arose from Gellis's social media campaign against Zuckerbrot and F-Factor. The lawsuit alleged Gellis used her platforms to amplify anonymous allegations to a large online audience, including claims of arsenic contamination, serious health harms and personal misconduct. In her public apology, Gellis acknowledged that the allegations she shared were based on anonymous submissions rather than verified medical, scientific or expert analysis.

releases.title: MEDIA ADVISORY - 2026 provincial election: practical information on voter turnout, counting of the votes and publication of results
releases.body:
QUÉBEC CITY, Oct. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- On October 5, Élections Québec will release several statistics eagerly awaited by the media.

Recording images at polling places

Media representatives may visit polling places to take photos and videos, but they must comply with the established rules. Election officers are not authorized to grant interviews.

Preliminary voter turnout

We will update the preliminary voter turnout twice. We will do so first around noon and a second time around 5 p.m.

In 2022, the preliminary turnout reported at noon was 29.20%. The turnout reported at 5 p.m. was 44.63%.

The final voter turnout was 66.15%.

Preliminary results on election night

Preliminary results will be released as the counting of the votes progresses on our website and in our open data. Data will be updated every two to five minutes.

The counting of the votes begins when all electors present in a polling place at closing time (8 p.m.) have voted and left the premises. Election officers count the votes cast manually at the polling station for which they are responsible. The pace of reporting depends on several factors, including the volume of ballots to count; we therefore cannot determine at what time the counting of the votes will end.

Advance poll

The counting of the votes cast at advance polls may begin as early as 6 p.m. That is why we can release the first results within an hour of the polling stations closing. But even if the votes in some ballot boxes have already been counted, between 6 p.m. and 8 p.m., no results can be released until the polling stations close at 8 p.m. because the election is not ended yet.

Thus, the results for most votes cast before election day will be released early in the evening. However, because some ballot boxes will be counted later, we cannot guarantee that all advance poll results will be disclosed early in the evening.

Given the high popularity of advance polling in certain electoral divisions, their first results might be released later than those of electoral divisions where advance polling is less popular.

Îles-de-la-Madeleine

Results for the Îles-de-la-Madeleine electoral division will be released at the same time as results for the rest of Québec, starting at 8 p.m., Eastern Time.

In Îles-de-la-Madeleine, polling stations are open from 9:30 a.m. to 8 p.m., Atlantic Time. They therefore close at 7 p.m., Eastern Time. However, because voting is not over elsewhere in Québec, the returning officer for this electoral division will wait until 9 p.m., Atlantic Time, before transmitting any results.

Voting by mail

During Québec elections, voting by mail is reserved for electors who are located in certain remote regions, in correctional institutions or outside Québec, temporarily. These ballot papers are all counted at the head office of Élections Québec.

Generally speaking, the number of votes by mail is low. In 2022, it represented 0.11% of the total number of votes cast in the general election.

Addition of the votes

On election night, the results are preliminary. They will be confirmed during the addition of the votes, which usually takes place the following morning, around 9 a.m., or when all ballot boxes have been returned to the office of the returning officer for each electoral division.

During the addition of the votes, the returning officer examines the statements of votes for each ballot box. They make sure that the results entered on the statements correspond to the results released on election night. If the returning officer notes a discrepancy between the information released on election night and the copies of the statement, they correct the results. The contents of the ballot boxes are not counted again.

At the end of the addition, the results are official. The ballot boxes are then closed and sealed.

Judicial recount

Generally, the results make it very clear who has been elected. But in certain contexts, ballot papers must be recounted during a judicial recount. 

Élections Québec cannot, on its own initiative, open a ballot box to validate the outcome of an election.

The Election Act provides for a four-day period following the addition of the votes during which a person may file a request for a judicial recount with the Court of Québec. The four-day period is calculated excluding any Saturday, Sunday or holiday. A judge must then grant or deny the request based on the grounds presented.

In electoral divisions where the addition of the votes takes place on October 6, the deadline to request a judicial recount will be October 13.

Three scenarios can lead to a judicial recount following a provincial election:

  • It takes place automatically if the first-place candidates have the same number of votes at the end of the addition of the votes.
  • The second-place candidate may request one if the difference in votes separating them from first place is less than 1/1000 of the votes cast.
  • Any person may file a request if they have reasonable grounds to believe that a deputy returning officer or the returning officer has unlawfully counted or rejected ballot papers or drawn up an incorrect statement of votes.

When a request for a judicial recount is filed and granted by the court, a judge oversees the recount of the votes. The counting of the votes must begin within four days of the judgment granting the request.

Declaration of election and final results

Following the four-day period, or once the court confirms the result of the votes, the returning officer declares that the candidate who received the most votes has been elected.

In most electoral divisions, the declaration of election will take place on Wednesday, October 14, due to the Thanksgiving holiday on Monday, October 12.

We retain all ballot papers, statements of votes and poll books for one year. They remain under seal; no one can access them, except the courts, if necessary.

Other statistics

  • Voter turnout history
  • Statistics on candidates – October 5, 2026

About Élections Québec

Élections Québec is a non-partisan and independent institution striving to ensure the integrity, transparency, and reliability of elections and to contribute to the vitality of the Québec democracy.

In practical terms, the institution organizes provincial elections in cooperation with the returning officers of Québec's 127 electoral divisions. In addition, it designs and offers several democracy education programs; it ensures compliance with the rules on political financing; and it acts as a public prosecutor to ensure compliance with Québec's electoral laws.

Our website includes a section for the media.

To receive our press releases by email, subscribe to our newsletter.

SOURCE Élections Québec

releases.body:
Cohort 3 Reflects Market Acceleration and Client Priorities as Marketing Technology Shifts From Insight to Action

NEW YORK, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Horizon Media today unveiled 11 companies named to the third cohort of HorizonOS Labs, the agency's structured innovation accelerator. With more than 50 partners having gone through the program, Horizon serves as a curator of emerging technology, simplifying the often time-consuming process of identifying, testing and scaling solutions so clients can build bespoke operating platforms around their unique business challenges. The program is designed to distinguish viable innovation from vendor promises through a transparent, client-centric process focused on real-world application.

"The market is moving faster than annual technology reviews can accommodate," said John Koenigsberg, EVP and Head of Platform Partnerships at Horizon Media Holdings. "One clear shift emerged from Cohort 3: the vast majority of partners are focused on growth, closing the loop between surfacing, modeling and finding – and actually driving action. What makes these capabilities valuable isn't any one of them alone, but what happens when they connect with each other and with what a brand already knows."

Cohort 3 is organized around three Growth Frontiers. They include: 

  • Unlocking Growth from the Customers You Already Know. Brands can now understand the people already connected to them far more deeply than before, and act on that understanding in the same motion, across the channels they own and the media they buy. 



  • Creative Supply at the Speed of Everything Else. Precision in targeting and measurement has raised what creative can be asked to do, and production has caught up—generating, versioning and governing at the volume a channel actually requires. 



  • Winning Customers When Machines Shape Discovery. More of the journey now runs through machines: search that answers rather than lists, assistants that shop, screens that decide what comes next. Presence in those spaces is earned differently, and it can now be measured, shaped and acted on. 

Each frontier unifies what was once fragmented: paid, owned and consumer insight; media and creative; and human strategy and intelligent workflows. The 11 Cohort 3 partners, chosen from more than 600 RFI submissions, reflect Horizon's commitment to an open ecosystem where clients can access best fit technologies without vendor lock-in or proprietary constraints.

The 11 were selected on what they can do: how readily they connect to the systems a client already operates, their willingness to work alongside other companies in the cohort, and concrete evidence that the work drives business outcomes.

"AI is changing the rules for how brands grow," said Bob Lord, President of Horizon Media Holdings. "The brands that will drive growth aren't looking for a better way to buy media. They're solving for customer value by building an operating platform that brings their data, customers, technology and people together around the problems that matter most to their business. There's no off-the-shelf answer to that. Horizon is committed to bringing the open ecosystem together to build the right capabilities for each customer."

The Cohort 3 Partners — Grouped by Growth Frontier — Include:

Unlocking Growth from the Customers You Already Know

  • SQREEM: SQREEM is a behavioral intelligence platform that builds real‑time, predictive audience and intent models from massive volumes of unstructured digital data (web, app, social, video) rather than relying on predefined segments or static taxonomies. 



  • Aaru: Aaru is a statistical simulation engine for predicting human behavior. Our platform enables organizations to test products, messaging, and strategies with simulated respondents to understand how people will react before making real-world decisions

    .
  • Zenapse: Zenapse is an emotionally intelligent, agentic marketing platform, purpose-built to quickly drive business outcomes through goal-based conversion optimization, personalization and data — all within existing media and workflows.



  • Hightouch: Hightouch is an agentic marketing platform where AI agents and marketing teams work together to brief, create, review, and launch campaigns across 300+ channels, guided by a shared "marketing brain" that learns from your brand, customer data, and every campaign's results.

Creative Supply at the Speed of Everything Else

  • AdGreetz: AdGreetz offers DCO+®, which personalizes any ad into unlimited, relevant, data-driven versions served to each viewer and AdChef®, which orchestrates 50+ AI models with Proprietary Creative Agents to generate original, broadcast-quality video, display, UGC/influencer, rich media, carousel and product ads from a brief, URL or prompt in minutes.



  • Storyteq: ITG is an AI-enabled content company that helps global brands deliver personalized content at scale. Powered by our Storyteq platform, ITG combines technology, data and production expertise to lower costs and lift ROAS by up to 300%. 



  • Anoki: Anoki AI is the contextual video intelligence company advancing CTV with ContextIQ and its award-winning AI Marketing Co-Pilot, helping every ad find its perfect home, scene by scene.

Winning Customers When Machines Shape Discovery

  • Bluefish: Bluefish is the Agentic Marketing Platform (AMP) for the Fortune 500.



  • EmberOS: emberos, the Operating System for AI brand management, shows brands what AI is about to say about them, helps them change it at the source, and proves the change worked.



  • Olyzon: Olyzon is an agentic orchestration layer for advertising: its agents connect to any buying interface through open protocols to plan, activate and optimize across platforms, starting with CTV and extending to YouTube, Social, DOOH and Audio, live today across managed accounts.



  • Fuse: FUSE+Emet is the truth infrastructure layer for AI data systems. AI doesn't know when it's wrong. Emet does.

The Cohort 3 partners will be showcased at an in-person event in New York on October 1, where they will present to Horizon clients and engage in discussions around potential pilot deployments. Following the showcase, partners will be matched with interested client brands to scope and advance specific pilots, with client participation helping determine which opportunities move forward. 

Looking ahead, HorizonOS Labs will open its next RFI process in early 2027.

About Horizon Media Holdings

Horizon Media Holdings is the privately-held parent company of Horizon Media, the largest U.S. media agency and the largest independent globally, with additional portfolio companies including – Horizon Next (full-service marketing); Horizon Commerce (commerce and digital experiences); Horizon Business (consulting, media and creative); One Horizon (full-service advertising); HS&E (sports and experiential); and Blue Hour Studios (influencer agency). Horizon Media Holdings has a 50/50 partnership with Havas Media Network in the performance-driven agency network, Horizon Global. Horizon Holdings drives enterprise-level innovation, fosters collaboration across its portfolio, and explores new growth opportunities and technology solutions to help its clients navigate the shifting marketing challenges of today and tomorrow.

releases.title: Financial Executives International Launches Media Finance Section
releases.body:
Financial leaders in media and entertainment join FEI's cross-industry community

as MFM members become FEI Members today

MORRISTOWN, N.J., Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Financial Executives International (FEI) today opened its Media Finance Section, the association's first industry-specific section and the new home for the members, programming and peer networks of the Media Financial Management Association (MFM). The Section gives financial leaders in media and entertainment a permanent place inside one of the longest-standing communities of senior-level corporate financial executives, and it gives that community a direct line into an industry that is rewriting how subscription, advertising, and content revenue is earned, valued and reported.

MFM members voted to approve the merger on July 15, 2026, following due diligence and board endorsement by both organizations. MFM, founded in 1961 and serving approximately 1,200 business and financial executives across broadcast, cable, publishing, streaming and digital media, now operates as FEI's Media Finance Section.

"Media and entertainment financial leaders are working through questions that much of corporate finance is only beginning to confront: bundled revenue, content valuation, structural separations and the use of AI in the close," said Andrej Suskavcevic, CAE, President and CEO of FEI. "Giving that work a named seat inside FEI does two things at once: it connects media finance professionals with peers across every industry, and it brings their hard-won experience to the broader finance community. Both were overdue."

What is live today

  • A dedicated Media Finance Section serving as the hub for media-specific programming, content, research and networking.
  • Full FEI membership for every former MFM member, including access to FEI's professional development, career services, publications and research through the Financial Education & Research Foundation (FERF).
  • Access to FEI's local Chapter network, a benefit not previously available to MFM members. Chapters add a second, geographic layer of peer connection alongside the industry one.
  • Continuity of the media finance programming members have relied on, including the Financial Leaders Forum, the Executive Summit, and the Section's webinar and education calendar.

"Our members were clear about what they wanted: their community intact and their programming stronger, not smaller," said Joseph Annotti, Executive Director of FEI's Media Finance Section and former President and CEO of MFM. "That is what today delivers. The Financial Leaders Forum, the peer networks and the media-specific education all continue, now with the research, Chapter network and professional voice of a larger organization behind them."

Why it matters

Finance teams across media and entertainment have absorbed a sustained run of structural change: revenue arriving through bundles and platform intermediaries rather than direct customer relationships, content assets whose carrying values move with shifting distribution strategy, mid-year separations of linear and streaming businesses, and advertising sold against inventory that did not exist in the prior reporting period. Those are no longer media-only problems. They are appearing across consumer products, software, sports and healthcare as more businesses shift from selling units to sustaining subscriptions.

Placing media finance inside a broader financial-executive community is intended to move expertise in both directions: cross-industry peer exchange, research capacity and policy voice for media finance professionals, and early visibility into emerging reporting and control questions for the wider membership.

Availability

Mackenzie Global Equity & Gold Overlay ETF (TSX: MGEG)

MGEG is an alternative mutual fund that combines an actively managed global equity allocation with a strategic 50% notional gold futures overlay in a single ETF. As global equity markets have become increasingly concentrated in U.S. equities, portfolios may also carry greater exposure to common U.S. market and currency drivers. Gold has historically exhibited different return drivers than global equities, while also demonstrating a negative historical relationship with the U.S. dollar, providing diversification.

"By implementing the gold allocation through futures, MGEG maintains full global equity exposure while adding strategic gold exposure in a capital-efficient structure," said Kristi Ashcroft, Executive Vice President, Products and Solutions, Mackenzie Investments. "Investors gain access to the diversification benefits of gold without having to reduce their allocation to global equities."

Mackenzie Modus Global Equity ETF (TSX: MMGL), Mackenzie Modus International Equity ETF (TSX: MMEA) and Mackenzie Modus Global Small-Mid Cap Equity ETF (TSX: MMSD)

Mackenzie Modus is the firm's new brand for a suite of rule-based factor investing strategies. Each Modus ETF systematically targets four established sources of return, value, momentum, quality and low volatility, using a defined and repeatable investment process, rather than relying on manager judgment. Each ETF holds a diversified portfolio built on those four factors while seeking to minimize exposure to uncompensated factors such as size, liquidity, country and sector biases.

MMGL invests primarily in mid and large cap companies globally, while MMSD invests in small and mid-cap companies globally. MMEA focuses on mid and large cap companies across developed markets outside the U.S. and Canada.

The initial offerings of the ETFs have closed, and they will begin trading today on the Toronto Stock Exchange under their respective ticker symbols.

For more information on Mackenzie's investment solutions, please visit mackenzieinvestments.com.

(NASDAQ: SHAZ) ("Sharon AI" or the "Company"), a leading Australian Neocloud delivering trusted AI infrastructure, today announced it has entered into its inaugural US$356m committed senior secured, GPU-backed SPV debt facility priced at a fixed rate of 9.95%, excluding fees.

"As demand for sovereign and secure, trusted AI infrastructure continues to outpace available supply globally, and particularly across Australia, New Zealand and the broader Asia-Pacific, access to scalable debt capital is an important enabler of our growth," said James Manning, Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of Sharon AI.

This is designed to enhance return on equity and ultimately drive increased long-term shareholder value. With a strong balance sheet, growing contracted capacity pipeline and a disciplined approach to capital allocation, we believe we are well positioned to continue scaling our AI platform across the Asia-Pacific region."

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Corgi Insurance today announced the launch of Golden by Corgi, a dedicated sports and entertainment insurance platform providing coverage for the organizations, events, facilities, and businesses that power the sports industry.

Golden provides insurance solutions for teams, leagues, federations, National Governing Bodies, tournaments, athletic facilities, sporting events, and other organizations operating across the sports ecosystem. The platform offers more than 20 lines of coverage designed around the specialized risks these organizations face.

Golden is led by Peter Akman and Mike T. Brown, former founders and professional athletes who bring experience building businesses and competing professionally. Their backgrounds have shaped Golden's approach to insurance, with a focus on the operational realities of sports organizations.

Through Corgi's surplus lines carrier, Golden can build customized insurance programs for organizations with specialized or complex coverage needs. The platform combines underwriting, claims, and risk management capabilities under one system, with certificates of insurance available in minutes and in-house claims handling.

"Sports is an incredibly diverse industry, and the insurance needs of a national governing body can look very different from those of a tournament, facility, or professional organization," said Peter Akman, Co-Founder of Golden. "We built Golden to give each organization the flexibility to build coverage around how it actually operates."

Golden is already working with National Governing Bodies and Olympic programs, including USA Fencing, as well as organizations across the broader sports ecosystem.

The platform is designed to support organizations throughout the lifecycle of their operations, from day-to-day activities and facilities to tournaments, events, athletes, and other specialized exposures.

"Insurance should not be another operational hurdle for sports organizations," said Mike T. Brown, Co-Founder of Golden. "Golden brings sports expertise together with Corgi's insurance infrastructure to make the process faster, simpler, and more tailored to the organizations we serve."

Golden is Corgi's dedicated sports and entertainment insurance platform, providing commercial insurance solutions for sports organizations across the United States. The platform offers more than 20 lines of coverage designed for the unique risks faced by teams, leagues, tournaments, facilities, events, and sports organizations of all sizes.

releases.body:
Telit Cinterion's NExT™ connectivity solutions provide reliable coverage and secure communications for Commstar Radio's customers across urban, rural and hard-to-reach environments

  • Commstar Radio selected Telit Cinterion to deliver secure, resilient and scalable connectivity for critical communications environments, including push-to-talk, utility workforce communications, fleet coordination, dispatch operations and remote infrastructure connectivity.
  • Built-in network redundancy keeps customers connected where single-carrier coverage falls short.

BOCA RATON, Fla., Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Telit Cinterion, a global enabler of the Internet of Things (IoT), today announced a partnership with Commstar Radio, a Wisconsin-based technology and communications company. Through the partnership, Commstar Radio will offer Telit Cinterion's NExT™ SIM connectivity solution, giving customers access to multiple carrier networks on a single SIM for secure communications in urban, rural and hard-to-reach areas.

For more information about Telit Cinterion's IoT connectivity solutions, visit: https://www.telit.com/telit-next-network/

The NExT SIM connectivity solution provides secure access through a single SIM to more than 600 mobile carrier networks globally, including the three major U.S. networks.  Built on Telit Cinterion's georedundant NExT global network, it supports cellular technologies from 2G to 5G and serves both low-power wide-area (LPWA) devices and high-bandwidth applications.

With NExT SIM, Commstar Radio can now offer customers resilient multi-network connectivity, extensive Cat M and narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) coverage and greater operational reliability across urban, rural and hard-to-reach environments.

Commstar Radio specializes in wireless communications and connectivity for organizations that depend on reliable service in demanding environments, including municipalities, utilities, transportation providers, field service teams and public infrastructure operators. Its services span land mobile communications, push-to-talk over cellular, wireless infrastructure connectivity, secure wireless services, mobile device management, cloud communications and cybersecurity.

The company serves customers across sectors such as:

  • Utilities
  • Field services
  • Local government
  • Energy
  • Transportation
  • Public infrastructure

An initial deployment with the Village of Reeseville, Wisconsin, demonstrates how Commstar Radio and Telit Cinterion are delivering resilient multi-network connectivity for municipal communications and public service operations.

"Commstar Radio has been a trusted and reliable partner for the Village of Reeseville since the company's inception," said Jake Pacala, village president, Reeseville, Wisconsin. "Municipalities require an abundance of services in this domain, making reliability and service a must. When asked by neighboring municipalities for recommendations in this field, Commstar Radio is the first we mention."

"Our customers depend on communications systems that work wherever their teams operate," said Kevin Hankes, president of Commstar Radio.  "By partnering with Telit Cinterion, we can provide resilient multi-network connectivity across urban and rural environments while giving customers greater reliability, security and flexibility than traditional single-carrier solutions."

"Organizations responsible for public services, utilities, transportation and field operations need connectivity that goes beyond a single carrier, leveraging multiple networks to protect critical operations," said Martin Krona, president of services and solutions at Telit Cinterion. "Together with Commstar Radio, we're enabling secure, resilient communications that can intelligently leverage multiple carrier networks to keep people, devices and operations connected."

About Telit Cinterion

Telit Cinterion is a global IoT leader with over 30 years of innovation experience. It provides modules, connectivity plans and services, platforms, and secure, scalable custom solutions.

Telit Cinterion's product portfolio supports mission-critical applications across industries. In addition, it simplifies lifecycle management and device-to-cloud security. The company helps enterprises connect, manage and grow their IoT systems with confidence.

OEMs, system integrators and service providers worldwide trust Telit Cinterion. The company drives digital transformation and unlocks the power of connected technology.

releases.title: NHRA ANNOUNCES NEW MEDIA RIGHTS AGREEMENTS WITH FOX SPORTS, THE CW NETWORK AND FLOSPORTS
releases.body:
Landmark, multi-year agreements will enable largest reach for NHRA Mission Foods

Drag Racing Series events in NHRA's 75-year history

INDIANAPOLIS, Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NHRA officials announced it has reached new, landmark multi-year media rights agreements for the Mission Foods Drag Racing Series with three standout distributors – FOX Sports, The CW Network and FloSports – positioning NHRA to enjoy the largest household reach in its 75-year history.

NHRA ANNOUNCES NEW MEDIA RIGHTS AGREEMENTS WITH FOX SPORTS, THE CW NETWORK AND FLOSPORTS

Starting during the 2027 season, NHRA will have a total reach of more than 125 million households, giving NHRA its biggest-ever media presence.

FOX Sports and The CW will carry all 20 NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series events on raceday, with FOX Sports showcasing the first 13 races of the 2027 campaign, which kicks off with the NHRA Winternationals on Feb. 18-21 at In-N-Out Burger Pomona Dragstrip. FOX Sports telecasts will continue to include a mix of coverage on the FOX broadcast network and FS1, as well as streaming on the FOX One app, showing eliminations action on Sunday as well as a qualifying highlight/recap show on Sundays.

As part of this historic arrangement, NHRA is also thrilled to welcome two new partners in The CW and FloSports, which will both broadcast NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series action for the first time.

The CW will be the exclusive broadcast home on raceday for the final seven races of the season, including the world's biggest drag race, the prestigious Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals, and the full six-race Countdown to the Championship playoffs. Sunday eliminations on The CW will also be available to stream on the ESPN App for ESPN Unlimited subscribers.

FloSports will make its FloRacing channel the streaming home for live qualifying action in the NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series and eliminations on Sunday. These events and the NHRA partnership will be supported by an extensive line-up of original content, editorial, and social programming on FloRacing.

"This is a truly major moment for NHRA and for the future of our sport. These agreements with FOX Sports, The CW Network and FloSports put NHRA racing in front of fans in more ways and on more platforms than ever before," NHRA President Glen Cromwell said. "Celebrating our 75th anniversary in 2026, we continue to see tremendous momentum and growth in our audience.

"These new media relationships give us a huge opportunity to build on that and continue to reach new fans and introduce them to the incredible competition, drivers, race teams and excitement that make NHRA Drag Racing so special. We're extremely proud of these agreements for our race teams, tracks and sponsors, and we're thrilled to see NHRA's continued growth with our partners at The CW Network, FOX Sports and FloSports."

The CW Network

NHRA will make its 2027 debut on The CW at the world's biggest drag race at Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park, kicking off what will be a massive seven-race stretch broadcasting eliminations on the network. The addition of The CW also ensures NHRA will enjoy the most over-the-air broadcasts in its history between FOX and The CW, giving the six-race Countdown to the Championship playoffs a larger household reach and its biggest spotlight yet.

Race fans will also be able to watch NHRA action on The CW via CW Sports streaming on The ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited subscription.

"The CW has quickly become a top-tier broadcast destination for motorsports fans, and we are thrilled to add NHRA events to our growing portfolio of CW Sports," said Mike Perman, Senior Vice President, CW Sports. "Beginning next fall, these seven adrenaline-packed NHRA playoff races will pair perfectly with the action of the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, making weekends on The CW the premier television home for all racing enthusiasts."

FOX Sports

NHRA and FOX Sports will continue a thriving relationship that first began in 2016 and continued with a multi-year extension in 2021. Starting in 2027, 2-3 of the first 13 events of the year will air on FOX, with the remaining airing on FS1, as well as coverage on the FOX One app.

Sundays on FOX Sports will also include a comprehensive recap/highlight show to set up elimination action. There will also be robust motorsports promotion in FS1 broadcast windows, a staple of the longtime collaboration between NHRA and FOX Sports.

"It's fantastic to continue our long-standing relationship with the NHRA," said Bill Wanger, FOX Sports EVP, Head of Programming and Scheduling. "With a sport built on speed, adrenaline and mechanical mastery, being able to continue to deliver the blink-of-an-eye action across FOX Sports platforms to the NHRA's dedicated fan base highlights the commitment to our motor sports lineup."

FloSports

NHRA and FloSports will enter into a first-ever agreement starting in 2027, with the platform serving as the live streaming home for NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series qualifying and eliminations.

Through the agreement, FloRacing will exclusively stream all rounds of qualifying live at every national event, marking an ideal opportunity for both partners. FloRacing will also show Sunday eliminations, with race fans able to enjoy NHRA racing, alongside the largest grassroots motorsports portfolio in the world with more than 1,800 race events fueling 365-day coverage of NASCAR, short track, sprint cars, dirt, drag racing, late model and more.

"The NHRA is the crown jewel of drag racing and is going to be a standout addition to a FloRacing portfolio that is quickly becoming an essential destination for drag racing fans," said Michael Rigsby, GM of FloRacing. "We plan to give fans a deep dive into the sport and its drivers that will extend beyond our live streaming coverage."

For more information on NHRA, including the full 2027 schedule or information on the rest of the 2026 campaign, visit www.nhra.com.

About NHRA

NHRA is the primary sanctioning body for the sport of drag racing in the United States. NHRA presents 20 national events featuring the NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series and NHRA Lucas Oil Drag Racing Series, as well as the JBS Equipment NHRA Pro Mod Drag Racing Series presented by Elite Motorsports and NHRA Flexjet Factory Stock Showdown™ at select national events. NHRA provides competition opportunities for drivers of all levels in the NHRA Summit Racing Series and NHRA Street Legal™. NHRA also offers the NHRA Jr. Street® program for teens and the Summit Racing Jr. Drag Racing League® for youth ages 5 to 17. With more than 100 Member Tracks, NHRA allows racers to compete at a variety of locations nationally and internationally. NHRA's Youth and Education Services® (YES) Program reaches over 30,000 students annually to ignite their interest in automotive and racing related careers. NHRA's streaming service, NHRA.tv®, allows fans to view all NHRA national events as well as exclusive features of the sport. In addition, NHRA owns and operates three racing facilities: Gainesville Raceway in Florida; Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park; and In-N-Out Burger Pomona Dragstrip in Southern California. For more information, log on to www.NHRA.com, or visit the official NHRA pages on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and YouTube.

releases.title: SHOPLINE and Entrepreneur Media Launch Partnership for Founders Growing Online Businesses
releases.body:
Founders get the guidance and commerce tools they need for wherever they are on their journey from their first product test to selling at scale.

LOS ANGELES and SANTA ANA, Calif., Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SHOPLINE, the global commerce platform serving more than 700,000 merchants worldwide, and Entrepreneur Media, which reaches founders through its magazines, entrepreneur.com, books, newsletters, and live and virtual events, today announced a partnership that pairs Entrepreneur's editorial depth with SHOPLINE's commerce platform through a research whitepaper, a webinar, and an affiliate program for founders ready to start selling.

The program is built for founders at every stage, from first concept and product testing to early sales and brands already running at scale. The whitepaper and the webinar take on the decisions all online sellers must face: how to set up a storefront, how to price and position a product, which sales channels to open, what to measure, and when to expand. Entrepreneur will lead the creation and distribution of the content; SHOPLINE will supply the commerce expertise behind it.

The affiliate program anchors the commercial side of the partnership, directing readers ready to open a store to a SHOPLINE landing page, where they can create a storefront, set up payments, and run marketing automation.

"Entrepreneurs have come to us since 1977 to bring an idea to life, and they show up with every kind of ambition," said Bill Shaw, President of Entrepreneur Media. "This partnership puts dreams into action. Somebody can think about opening a store on a Tuesday morning and be building it that afternoon."

With Spotlights, brands seamlessly launch Meta Partnership Ads and TikTok Spark Ads from content that is already driving affiliate sales, all from within the ShopMy platform.

NEW YORK, Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ShopMy, the curator commerce platform for the world's most premium brands, creators, and shoppers, today announced Spotlights, a product that turns proven creator content into paid ads across Meta and TikTok. Spotlights leverages the creator relationships, content, and data brands already have inside ShopMy for an always-on paid program that gets smarter every time it runs. The product joins Affiliate, Opportunities, and Lookbooks as the final and critical step in ShopMy's full-funnel creator marketing system.

ShopMy announces Spotlights, a product that turns proven creator content into paid ads across Meta and TikTok.

The Problems Spotlights Solves:

While organic creator marketing is incredibly efficient at driving new site visits, much of that traffic leaves without converting. Meanwhile, paid ads are great at retargeting and converting returning shoppers, but struggle to scale without creative feeling repetitive. Spotlights bridges this divide, pairing the trust and creative diversity of creator content with the precision of paid performance.

Meta's own data shows that creator-led ads drive 13% higher CTR and 19% lower CPA than standard ads, and brands using TikTok Spark Ads have seen up to 25% higher CTR and 24% higher conversion rates compared to standard in-feed ads. Despite this impact, most brands can only run a handful of creator ads due to manual sourcing, upfront fees, and approval processes that cap volume before scale is possible.

Spotlights flips the traditional model, leveraging proven content to create a scalable, pay-for-performance ad program that is built to convert.

How Spotlights Works

  • Proven Content: Organic content is surfaced based on real performance affiliate data, so brands can invest in proven-to-convert content. Standard creator commission replaces a flat production fee, removing risk for brands.
  • Easy Approvals. Creators can turn on Instant Spotlights to pre-approve requests from brands they mention, or manually approve them from inside the ShopMy platform, turning organic content into high-performing ads within minutes.
  • Optimized Return On Ad Spend (ROAS). Faster approvals and no upfront fees mean more content in-market, which in turn gives brands the ability to test quickly and continuously.
  • Precise Control. Brands can build Spotlight strategies by product, market, or funnel stage, each with its own targeting, budget and outcome to optimize toward.
  • On a Centralized Platform. Spotlights runs on the creator relationships, content, data, and sales history already inside a brand's ShopMy account, eliminating the need for separate platforms.

"Spotlights transforms creator marketing from a brand awareness channel to a conversion channel," says Harry Rein, co-founder and CEO of ShopMy. "Brands can put a massive library of creator content to work as paid ads, reaching high-intent shoppers without the extra legwork. For the first time, brands can run their entire marketing program through ShopMy in a cohesive, consistent, brand-accretive way."

ShopMy's Spotlights ad partners were quick to recognize the product's value.

"'TikTok made me buy it' became a trend because so many people discover, decide, and buy through TikTok. Our partnership with ShopMy connects that moment to the scale and measurement rigor of paid media. With the Content Suite API, ShopMy can connect its affiliate content on TikTok directly to Spark Ads, so brands can amplify authenticity with proven results to reach even more people." — Jeffrey Huai, Global Product Lead for Creator Ads at TikTok

Early Results

MUTHA, a luxury skincare brand, increased its live partnership ads to over 100 in a single month, grew GMV by 140% over its pre-Spotlights monthly average, and saw a 55% lift over its standard Meta ROAS. Additionally, the number of creators earning through MUTHA grew roughly 62% over the same period.

"In an age where AI-generated content is growing exponentially, real creators bring authenticity and credibility. ShopMy allows us to use that trust to grow our brand, and we will continue to shift more paid media spend to Spotlights to take advantage of that." said Mick Burchfield, VP Sales & Marketing, MUTHA.

A few months after turning on Instant Spotlights, New York City-based fashion and lifestyle creator Marissa Huertas-Crespo now earns more than 60% of her lifetime ShopMy commissions through Spotlights.

"Spotlights has been a game changer for me," she says. "Content I shared months ago has been given a second, third, or sometimes even fourth life by turning on Instant Spotlights, in addition to helping me reach new audiences as well. I love how hands-off and effortless it is, especially as a creator balancing content and a full-time career."

About ShopMy: ShopMy is the creator commerce infrastructure that connects premium brands, curators, and consumers through taste and trust. Brands including Rhode, Kallmeyer, Net-a-Porter, Gucci, West Elm, and Therabody use ShopMy's affiliate tracking, gifting, and performance tools to work with a network of 330,000+ curated tastemakers.

Spotlights is available now to ShopMy brand partners.

releases.title: Kubota Introduces All-New BX90 Sub-Compact Tractor Series: Bigger, Better, More Capable
releases.body:
America's Long-Time Trusted Sub-Compact Tractor Line Just Got a Major Upgrade

GRAPEVINE, Texas, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kubota Tractor Corporation, the #1-selling tractor brand in the USA for 20 years running,* today unveiled its all-new sub-compact tractor line, the BX90 Series. As the pioneer of the sub-compact category, Kubota introduced the original BX Series in 2000, and 26 years later, the company is once again reinventing the segment by introducing five new models with three trim levels: the BX2190, BX2390 Deluxe, and BX2690 Premium, plus the backhoe-equipped BX2390S and BX2690S Premium. The new BX90 Series represents a complete platform redesign built specifically around what property owners want: all-day comfort, real loader power, and exceptional mowing performance, all in one sub-compact machine.

"The BX90 Series was designed around what today's property owners value most: productivity, comfort, and choice, while building on the quality and versatility that has made Kubota a trusted leader in sub-compact tractors," said Matt McDonald, Senior Product Operations Manager, Kubota Tractor Corporation. "From intuitive side-by-side HST pedals to enhanced loader and mower systems, every improvement is intended to help customers accomplish more with ease. And with three distinct trim levels, customers can choose the BX90 that best fits their property, applications, and priorities. At the top of the lineup, the Premium model brings modern displays, programmable settings, and advanced controls traditionally associated with larger tractors, combining the proven BX experience with technology designed around how customers work."

Three Core Advancements: Loader Capability, Mower Performance and Operator Comfort

Three platform-wide advancements form the foundation of every model in the new BX90 Series: improved loader capability, heavy-duty mower performance and more intuitive operation. Together, these enhancements elevate productivity, versatility and operator comfort across the entire BX90 lineup.

  • Increased Loader Capability: The BX90 Series raises loader productivity with redesigned LA355 and LA405 loaders offering lift capacities of up to 721 and 904 pounds, respectively. The BX2390 and BX2690 models pair increased hydraulic flow and pressure with quicker cycle times and stronger response at lower engine speeds. Dual bucket cylinders, an improved rollback angle, protected hose routing, and an easier-to-align loader cradle are designed to support efficient operation, improve material retention, and enable more convenient loader attachment and removal.
  • Heavy-Duty Mower Performance: The new 54-inch and 60-inch mower decks combine durable welded-steel construction with the flexibility to choose either pin-on or drive-over capability. The available Swift-Mount™ auto coupling driveline connects as the tractor travels over the deck, making attachment faster and more convenient.
  • Operator Comfort and Intuitive Control: The all-new side-by-side HST pedals create a more natural operating position and make forward and reverse changes feel intuitive, helping operators work with greater comfort, confidence, and control.

Five BX90 Models Ready to Work Year-Round

The BX90 Series delivers the year-round versatility property owners expect from Kubota, from clearing snow and preparing gardens to mowing lawns, managing seasonal cleanup and moving material. With enhanced loader capability, multiple mower options and compatibility with a wide range of implements, the BX90 is equipped to take on the changing demands of property ownership. Five available models give customers the flexibility to choose the capability, convenience, price point, and technology that best fit the way they work.

  • BX2190 (19.3 gross horsepower): An accessible entry point to the BX90 lineup, combining essential BX versatility with the platform-wide enhancements and the LA355 loader. Its increased horsepower also supports larger tires and 60-inch mower-deck compatibility.
  • BX2390 Deluxe (21.6 gross horsepower): Balances capability, convenience and value with redesigned styling, compatibility with the high-performance LA405 loader, and upgraded controls that include electronically controlled PTO engagement, three-point hitch position control, telescopic stabilizers and simplified mower-deck height adjustment.
  • BX2690 Premium (23.9 gross horsepower): The most advanced BX model to date, featuring an electronically controlled engine, full-color LCD display, programmable engine-speed settings, and joystick-integrated throttle-up functionality, which provides on-demand, fingertip access to preset engine speeds for faster hydraulic response and more engine power during loader work.
  • BX2390S and BX2690S Premium: Two backhoe-equipped configurations featuring the new BT604 backhoe, a dedicated flip-up seat and an automatic stabilizer lock. The BX2690S Premium adds the LA405 loader and enhanced hydraulic performance for greater working capability.

The new BX90 Series will be available at Kubota authorized dealerships beginning in early 2027. For more information, visit KubotaUSA.com/BX.

*Based on total U.S. unit sales from EDA/UCC equipment transaction data for all tractor classes (Utility Tractor, Utility Loader, Utility TLB, and 4WD Ag Tractor) from 01/01/2005 through 12/31/2025.

About Kubota Tractor Corporation

Kubota Tractor Corporation, Grapevine, Texas, is the U.S. marketer and distributor of Kubota-engineered and manufactured machinery and equipment, including a complete line of tractors up to 200* Gross hp, performance-matched implements, compact construction equipment, consumer lawn and garden equipment, hay tools, commercial turf products, and utility vehicles. For product literature or dealer locations, contact: Kubota Tractor Corporation, 1000 Kubota Drive, Grapevine, TX 76051, (888) 4-KUBOTA [(888) 458-2682], Ext. 900, or visit KubotaUSA.com. *factory estimated rating.

BX90 Sub-Compact Tractor Description:

Kubota Tractor Corporation introduced the all-new BX90 Series, featuring five models designed to meet the evolving needs of today's property owners. Building on the BX Series that helped pioneer the sub-compact tractor category, the BX90 introduces platform-wide advancements in loader capability, mower performance and operator comfort. The five-model lineup features redesigned loaders offering up to 904 pounds of lift capacity, new 54-inch and 60-inch welded-steel mower decks with available Swift-Mount Deck™ auto coupling technology, and all-new side-by-side HST pedals for natural, intuitive forward and reverse control. The BX2690 Premium further advances the operator experience with modern display technology, programmable settings and advanced operating functions traditionally associated with larger tractor platforms. Designed for year-round versatility, the BX90 Series will be available at authorized Kubota dealerships beginning early 2027.

releases.title: Simple Interact Partners with Brookes Publishing to Automate ASQ®-3 Developmental Screenings
releases.body:
DALLAS, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Brookes Publishing, a leading provider of early childhood resources and assessments, and Simple Interact, a leading healthcare front-office automation platform and 2025 & 2026 Best in KLAS® awardee for Patient Intake Management, are excited to announce the availability of the Ages & Stages Questionnaires®, Third Edition (ASQ®-3) through its platform as a result of a new partnership between the two companies.

Through this new collaboration, pediatric practices, FQHCs, and health systems will be able to electronically administer and automatically score the ASQ®-3 screening tool. For decades, healthcare professionals have relied on the ASQ®-3 to assess the developmental progress of children between the ages of 1 month and 5.5 years. Through the mobile-friendly, multilingual Simple Interact platform, clinics will be able to automatically assign the appropriate ASQ®-3 questionnaire to families based on the child's age and the type of medical appointment the child is scheduled for. These questionnaires can be sent via SMS or email to parents and guardians prior to the child's clinic visit, allowing them to complete the screenings in place of the clinic's intake and check-in forms and without needing to download any health and intake applications.

"Developmental screening is incredibly important, but often adds to the workload of healthcare providers who must complete the administration of these questionnaires and scoring of those responses," said Ravi Kalidindi, Founder and CEO of Simple Interact. "By making the ASQ-3 automated and integrated with the Simple Interact platform, we make it simpler for parents to complete these screenings and for healthcare providers to focus on patient care."

The addition of the ASQ-3 to Simple Interact expands the platform's capabilities to meet specialized screening needs and the unique requirements of each healthcare organization. Simple Interact's mobile-friendly, multilingual platform automates a variety of front-office processes, including patient intake, check-in, consents, screenings, reminders, two-way texting, patient feedback, scheduling, payments, and other patient interactions.

"For decades, ASQ has helped healthcare professionals and families identify and support children's developmental needs with confidence," said Douglas Solomon, Chief Strategy Officer at Brookes Publishing. "Partnering with Simple Interact allows us to extend that impact through Simple Interact's digital platform, making it easier than ever to administer screenings accurately and use the results to promote the healthy development of all children."

About Simple Interact

Simple Interact is a leading front office automation company and a 2025 & 2026 Best in KLAS® awardee. We help healthcare facilities across the United States run more efficiently and profitably by digitizing and streamlining their critical workflows. We collaborate closely with providers to customize our platform, transforming patient experience, boosting staff productivity, and driving provider success. Our platform integrates seamlessly with major EHR systems, ensuring that these improvements work in harmony with existing clinical workflows. Learn more at simpleinteract.com

About Brookes Publishing

For more than 40 years, Brookes Publishing has provided professional resources and assessments in early childhood, communication and language, and special education. Ages & Stages Questionnaires® are developmental and social-emotional screening tools used by early childhood and healthcare professionals worldwide. Learn more at agesandstages.com

releases.title: Spin Master and Universal Announce Licensing Agreement for a Preschool Line Inspired by the Jurassic World Franchise from Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment
releases.body:
TORONTO, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Spin Master Corp. today announced a toy licensing agreement with Universal for a preschool toy line inspired by the Jurassic World franchise from Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment. Designed for dinosaur-loving kids ages 2–5, the collection will open a playful gateway into the Jurassic World universe, bringing colossal action-packed adventure down to size for young dinosaur fans through humor, discovery and age-appropriate play.

Spin Master's toy collection will feature roarsome dinosaurs, hands-on discovery and imaginative storytelling for first-time explorers. Blending excitement and adventure, the line is designed with preschoolers' developmental needs and natural play patterns in mind, helping them feel capable, confident and part of the action while exploring their fascination with dinosaurs and the prehistoric world.

"A preschool collection inspired by the iconic Jurassic World franchise opens the door for the youngest fans to experience the wonder of dinosaurs in a way that's built just for them," said Doug Wadleigh, Spin Master's President of Toys. "The collection introduces dinosaur-driven action play with a touch of humor and open-ended discovery, giving young fans the chance to interact with dinosaurs in an expressive and approachable way." 

"Jurassic World has captivated generations of fans by bringing the wonder, excitement and adventure of dinosaurs to life, and we're thrilled to collaborate with Spin Master to create toys designed specifically for our youngest explorers," said Rafa Macias, EVP, Global Consumer Products & Games, Universal Destinations & Experiences.

Under the global agreement, excluding China and Japan, Spin Master will develop a broad range of preschool toys, expected to launch in 2028 at major retailers.

This newest license joins a growing lineup of Universal franchises within Spin Master's portfolio, including Gabby's Dollhouse, How to Train Your Dragon, Wicked: For Good, the 2026 Toy of the Year award-winning Jurassic World Primal Hatch interactive toy, the viral Hatchin' Yoshi egg, and the upcoming launch of the Hellbreak™ trading card game, further building on the companies' longstanding relationship.

About the JURASSIC WORLD Franchise

From Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment, Jurassic World immerses audiences of all ages in a new era of wonder and thrills where dinosaurs and humankind must learn to coexist. Jurassic World is more than a film franchise. At every turn, this $6 billion film series delivers a larger-than-life destination for exploration, discovery, and epic adventure. Dinosaurs live again and they live in Jurassic World.  

About Spin Master

Spin Master Corp. (TSX:TOY) is a leading global children's entertainment company, creating exceptional play experiences across its three creative centres: Toys, Entertainment and Digital Games. With worldwide toy distribution, Spin Master is best known for award-winning brands including PAW Patrol®, Melissa & Doug®, Bakugan® and Rubik's® Cube, and is the global toy licensee for other iconic properties. Through its in-house entertainment studio, the company creates and produces captivating multiplatform content including powerhouse preschool franchise PAW Patrol, along with other original shows, short-form series and feature films. With an established presence in digital games anchored by Toca Boca® and Piknik™, Spin Master engages close to 60 million active users monthly in open-ended, creative and safe play. With 29 offices spanning nearly 20 countries, Spin Master employs close to 2,500 team members globally. 

About Universal Consumer Products & Games

Universal Consumer Products & Games (UCPG) brings NBCUniversal's iconic characters, stories and franchises into fans' everyday lives through innovative consumer products, games and digital experiences. Working with world-class licensees, retailers and strategic partners around the globe, UCPG creates products and experiences across toys, collectibles, apparel, publishing, home, lifestyle, video games and emerging digital platforms. Its diverse portfolio includes beloved properties from Universal Pictures, Illumination, DreamWorks Animation, Focus Features, Peacock and NBC. UCPG is a line of business within Universal Destination & Experiences' Franchise, Products & Partnerships team.

releases.title: Shipyard Joins StackGen, Adding Ephemeral Environments to the Autonomous Operations Factory
releases.body:
SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- StackGen, the autonomous operations company, today announced it has acquired Shipyard, the ephemeral environments platform used by engineering teams at fast growing startups like Rippit and major enterprises like PepsiCo. Shipyard creates a full-stack environment for every pull request and removes it on merge. Shipyard's engineering and customer team joins StackGen, and the product continues for existing and new customers as Shipyard by StackGen, while Shipyard will also power new capabilities for StackGen's Autonomous Operations Factory. Terms were not disclosed.

AI agents now write a growing share of code and propose more of the changes that reach production. StackGen & Shipyard believe every one of those changes should run somewhere real before it ships. Shipyard gives teams that place: an isolated environment built from the application's own definition, where a change is tested against the full stack and then thrown away. Engineers get their own environment on every pull request, wired into the GitHub and GitLab workflows they already use.

Shipyard works at the pull request, where a change starts its path to production. StackGen's Autonomous Operations Factory coordinates Aiden agents for infrastructure, delivery, observability and incident response on a shared world model. StackGen will bring Shipyard's environments into the factory as the place those agents prove a change before it reaches a live system.

"Agents are proposing more changes to production every week, and enterprises want proof before they let those changes run," said Sachin Aggarwal, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of StackGen. "Shipyard gives every change a real environment to prove itself in first. It is a strong business with enterprise and startup customers, and a team that has built a product engineers enjoy using. Bringing it into StackGen moves us toward production operations that agents can run safely."

"We started Shipyard so engineers could see their changes running before they merged them," said Benjie De Groot, co-founder of Shipyard. "More and more of those environments are now requested by agents. StackGen is building a place where agents prove their changes before they reach production, and Shipyard fits right into that. It's the right home for our customers and our team."

Customer quote

"We've been Shipyard customers for years and we've been very happy with it. Every pull request gets a high-fidelity environment where our browser tests run before anything merges. With more and more PRs coming in from agents, that step matters more than ever." - Harrison Hunter, CTO, Rippit

For Shipyard customers

Customers keep the product, contracts and support contacts they have today. Shipyard by StackGen continues on its own site at shipyard.build.

Availability

Shipyard by StackGen is available today at shipyard.build. Enterprise teams can book a demo at stackgen.com.

About StackGen

StackGen is the autonomous operations company. Its Autonomous Operations Factory takes software from commit to production and keeps it running, with Aiden agents for infrastructure, delivery, observability and incident response operating on a shared world model under policy-bound, auditable, human-on-the-loop governance. StackGen works inside the tools enterprises already use, such as GitHub, Jenkins, Datadog, PagerDuty and ServiceNow, and serves customers including Autodesk, Nielsen and Bancolombia. Recognized as a Gartner Cool Vendor and in Gartner Hype Cycle research, StackGen is backed by Thomvest Ventures, Seligman Ventures, WestWave Capital, Firebolt Ventures and Secure Octane, and is headquartered in San Francisco. For more information, visit stackgen.com.

About Shipyard

Shipyard, now Shipyard by StackGen, provides ephemeral environments for software teams and their coding agents. It creates a full-stack environment for every pull request, integrates with GitHub and GitLab, and gives agents access through an MCP server and CLI. Learn more at shipyard.build.

releases.body:
JPMorgan Chase captures No. 1; Alphabet, Coca-Cola, Amazon and NVIDIA round out top 5

In partnership with ServiceNow, Fortune AIQ 75 Ranks Fortune 500 Companies Turning AI Into Positive Business Results

2nd annual ranking recognizes companies across 18 sectors; 36 companies make their AIQ debut

NEW YORK and SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fortune and ServiceNow today unveiled the 2026 Fortune AIQ 75, an expanded annual ranking of Fortune 500 companies generating significant, measurable impact from AI adoption. JPMorgan Chase captured No. 1 in the prestigious ranking. ServiceNow's 2026 Enterprise AI Maturity Index research served as the foundation for the methodology behind the Fortune AIQ 75 List.

Building on the inaugural 2025 Fortune AIQ 50, the 2026 list grows to 75 companies – with 36 new companies added to the ranking – spanning 18 sectors across Technology, Finance, Healthcare, Energy, Retail, and Industrials. The expansion reflects the rapidly widening adoption and impact of AI across the American corporate landscape.

The debut of the Fortune AIQ 75 list comes two days before the inaugural Fortune AIQ Summit hosted at the New York Stock Exchange in New York City on Thursday, October 1. The invite-only AIQ Summit will draw attendees and speakers from the Fortune AIQ 75.

The Fortune AIQ Summit will feature cross-industry conversations offering actionable insights on what separates successful AI implementations from stalled pilots. Participants will explore how to identify the right use cases, redesign workflows, and scale AI across an enterprise to deliver quantifiable business outcomes.

Together, the companies on the 2026 Fortune AIQ 75 represent $7.58 trillion in revenue, $1.33 trillion in profits, and $32.1 trillion in market value. Technology and Finance are the two most represented sectors, while New York and California are home to more AIQ 75 companies than any other states.

THE TOP TEN COMPANIES ON THE FORTUNE 2026 AIQ 75 LIST ARE: 

  1. JPMorgan Chase
  2. Alphabet
  3. Coca-Cola
  4. Amazon
  5. Nvidia
  6. Mastercard
  7. Visa
  8. Carrier Global
